While Lip settles for a new job, Carl finally finds his calling in a new role on the police force. Debbie plunges into a treacherous world when she meets someone new. Frank comes to terms with his own mortality.

1.o: As college radio host Samantha White leads the outcry over a blackface party on campus, a revelation about her love life puts her in an awkward spot.

2.o: Buoyed by his front-page story on the party, shy reporter Lionel begins to come out of his shell and embrace his true identity.

3.o: Golden boy Troy schmoozes his way around campus at his dad's behest, campaigning for student body president. But his smile hides nagging doubts.

4.o: As Coco gears up for an exclusive soiree, a fight with Sam stirs up memories of their friendship -- and the differences that drove them apart.

5.o: Friends drag Reggie out on the town to stop him from brooding over the revolution and Sam's new beau. But the night takes a harrowing turn.

6.o: Shell-shocked, Sam and company plan a protest against the campus police, while Reggie finds his own way to process the ordeal.

7.o: Picking up on the chemistry between Sam and Reggie, Gabe obsesses over the state of his relationship -- and makes a startling confession to Joelle.

8.o: To show just how pervasive Winchester's race problems are, Lionel sets out to write a feature on Troy and makes some unexpected discoveries.

9.o: Coco jumps at the chance to join Troy at a party for wealthy donors, but the evening leaves her questioning his priorities.

10.o: With tensions running high before the town hall, Sam tries to patch up her relationship, Coco steals Troy's thunder, and Lionel makes a bold move.

3.o: While party-hopping on Pride Night, Lionel struggles to make small talk with strangers and decipher mixed signals from Silvio.

9.o: A family emergency draws Sam home, where she wrestles with feelings of guilt and stumbles across a piece of Winchester history.

10.o: As the campus braces for Rikki Carter's speech, Sam and Lionel piece together the clues they've gathered on the secret society known as Order of X.

1.o: Cocona is having an average day until a girl with a hover board takes her into another dimension. With nothing but their wits, their adventure begins.

2.o: Cocona refuses to meet with Papika, and she's afraid to let her true feelings show about their last adventure. Papika isn’t about to give up that easily!

3.o: Stranded on a deserted planet, Papika is trying to find Cocona. Meanwhile, Cocona must fight her way out of a terrifying illusion.

1.t: What is evil? Whatever springs from weakness.
1.o: Melancholy, unmotivated Kiyotaka Ayanokouji attends his first day at Tokyo Metropoiltan Advanced Nurturing High School, a government-established institution for training a generation of Japan's best and brightest. In this school, it is said, everything is decided based on merit, which includes the generous monthly "point" allowance students can spend at local shops. As Ayanokouji begins navigating this system, he also nurtures curious relationships with aloof fellow outsider Suzune Horikita and the terminally gregarious Kikyou Kushida.

2.t: It takes a great talent and skill to conceal one's talent and skill.
2.o: 1-D learn more about point system. They need to change their habits if they want to score some. But few students don't want to change even if they are facing expulsion.

3.t: Man is an animal that makes bargains: no other animal does this - no dog exchanges bones with another.
3.o: Kiyotaka explains to Suzune what he did last three days before test. And why everybody get such good scores on tests. But Sudo failed tests anyway and is going to be expelled.

4.t: We should not be upset that others hide the truth from us, when we hide it so often from ourselves.
4.o: Classrooms analyze their and others test results. Points distribution is late. Three students from 1-C reported Sudo for attacking them.

5.o: Kiyotaka and Kushida go with Sakura to he mall where Sakura will try to repair her camera. After that Kiyotaka talk to Sakura about Sado's situation and should she talk about what she saw.

6.t: There are two kinds of lies; one concerns an accomplished fact, the other concerns a future duty.
6.o: Sakura received some weird messages on her portal, than some pictures of herself. Kiyotaka and Suzune are trying to find evidence that would set Sudo free.

7.t: Nothing is as dangerous as an ignorant friend; a wise enemy is to be preferred.
7.o: Even during summer vacation, lone wolf Horikita would rather remain locked in her room studying than interacting with others. One day, Ayanokouji invites her to visit the pool with some of the others.

8.t: Abandon all hope, ye who enter here.
8.o: All students go to the cruise. Chabashira informs Kiyotaka that somebody requested his expulsion. If he don't help others to promote to A class she will use first opportunity to expel him.

9.t: Man is condemned to be free.
9.o: As part of a special test, the school has brought the students to an uninhabited tropical island where they must now live for a week. Their performance on the test can have an enormous impact on the point standings of the four classes.

10.t: Every man has in himself the most dangerous traitor of all.
10.o: Class D has achieved a degree of unity in facing the special test, so Ayanokouji and Horikita head out to see how the other classes are getting along. Class B is working together to make a comfortable life for themselves, while Class A remains secretive.

11.t: What people commonly call fate is mostly their own stupidity.
11.o: With the panty thief incident already eroding Class D's trust, Horikita finds her leader key card stolen. While they try to figure out who did it, the base camp is thrown into chaos with a new incident of arson.

12.t: Genius lives only one story above madness.
12.o: Survival test is coming to the end. Things don't look well for 1-D. Key card is stolen. And now Suzune is forced to withdraw due to her sickness. Kiyotaka will try to turn things around.

1.t: Remember to keep a clear head in difficult times.
1.o: With the island test over, Ayanokoji Kiyotaka and the others are enjoying their summer vacation on a luxury liner. Suddenly, they're interrupted by a new special test. Ayanokoji is called into the same room as Karuizawa Kei and others, where they learn that this test isn't strictly along class lines...

2.t: There are two main human sins from which all the others derive: impatience and indolence.
2.o: With Day 1 of the "thinking" test over, Ayanokoji is talking to Hirata and the others about a way to break out of the stalemate when he receives a message on his phone from an irritated Horikita. Meanwhile, noticing something strange about Karuizawa's behavior, he seeks information from Horikita, but...

3.t: The greatest souls are capable of the greatest vices as well as of the greatest virtues.
3.o: Karuizawa is pushed to her breaking point by the girls of Class C. Ayanokoji watches impassively, but Yukimura flies to her aid, unable to bear it. Noticing Karuizawa's abnormal levels of fear, Ayanokoji seems to get an idea...

4.t: The material has to be created.
4.o: At the start of the second term, preparations for the sports festival begin. The students are nervous about the fact that performance in the events will affect their written tests, and even more pressure is added by the unique team breakdowns and freedom given to the students to decide who takes part in what event.

5.t: Every failure is a step to success.
5.o: Ayanokoji brings Kushida, whom he suspects of being a traitor, to observe the other classes alongside Horikita. When the day of the festival arrives, Team Red pulls into the lead with great performances by Horikita and Sudo, but Ayanokoji merely watches with disinterest...

6.t: Adversity is the first path to truth.
6.o: As the sports festival comes down to the wire, Horikita must deal with Sudo, as well as Ryuen's threat.

7.t: To doubt everything or to believe everything are two equally convenient solutions; both dispense with the necessity of reflection.
7.o: Class D prepares to face their next major challenge, a test called "Paper Shuffle" where the price of failure is expulsion.

8.t: The wound is at her heart.
8.o: Horikita decides to use Paper Shuffle to settle matters with Kushida, and Ayanokoji finds himself caught in the middle.

9.t: If you make a mistake and do not correct it, this is called a mistake.
9.o: As the day of the Paper Shuffle draws near, the plans of the various forces in play collide.

10.t: People, often deceived by an illusive good, desire their own ruin.
10.o: Ayanokoji receives a visit from outside the school, and learns more about the conditions of his stay.

11.t: A man who cannot command himself will always be a slave.
11.o: Karuizawa, whose cooperative relationship with Ayakoji has ended abruptly, cannot hide her embarrassment at the complete loss of contact with him. As Class D discusses their plans for the future, Ryuen and the other members of Class C appear overbearing.

12.t: Force without wisdom falls of its own weight.
12.o: Ayanokoji makes his final decision on how to deal with Ryuen and the Class C threat.

13.t: The worst enemy you can meet will always be yourself.
13.o: The aftermath of the gymnasium incident plays out as Christmas brings romance to the school.

1.t: The strongest principle of growth lies in the human choice.
1.o: Ayanokoji's class embarks on their first trial as the ascended Class C, the mixed training camp.

2.o: Yukimura injures his leg while the group is training for the upcoming tests. He later devises a plan for how the group should handle the marathon and then the day of the four tests arrives.

3.t: Man never forgets what he wants to forget.
3.o: While Class C are discussing Karuizawa and Hirata's break up Yamauchi is approached by Sakayanagi from Class A. Horikita warns that it's a trap, but Yamauchi pays it no heed. Meanwhile, Horikita tells Ayanokoji that rumors are swirling around Ichinose.

4.t: To work you have the right, but not to the fruits thereof.
4.o: It's Valentine's Day and the boys of Class C are excited about whether or not they will receive chocolates. Meanwhile, Karuizawa seems uneasy over Ayanokoji's request to meet up and while doing so an unexpected person appears...

5.o: Turns out the one spreading the rumors was Hashimoto, who did so at the behest of Sakayanagi. Shortly thereafter, Sakayanagi appears before Class C and she informs them she has evidence regarding the rumors about Ichinose.

6.t: It is better to receive an injury than to inflict one.
6.o: Everyone in Class C has passed their year-end exam. While relief flows through the classroom, Chabashira announces a special exam. It will be a class vote to choose three people worthy of praise and three worthy of censure.

7.t: People will do anything, no matter how absurd, in order to avoid facing their own souls
7.o: With the approaching class vote, a disturbing atmosphere hangs over Class C and fills them with suspicion. Second-year Class A's Asahina informs Ayanokoji that Ichinose has asked for cooperation from student council president Nagumo.

8.t: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
8.o: After conversing with her brother Manabu, Horikita offers Yamauchi name as the one who should be expelled. Not only has he made few contributions to the class, but he also worked with Sakayanagi in Class A to expel Ayanokoji.

9.o: The class vote has seen the first student expelled from Class C. Sakayanagi meets up with Ayanokoji and they're approached by a man named Tsukishiro sent by Ayanokoji's father. Afterward Ayanokoji challenges Sakayanagi to compete on their next exam.

10.t: The first cause of absurd conclusions I ascribe to the want of method.
10.o: Class C considers various strategies for the special exam, but they all lack a decisive factor. Hirata remains disappointed in the class vote result. Ayanokoji calls out to Hirata, who acts coldly towards Mii-chan who is worried about him.

11.t: There is only one rule in love: bring happiness to those you love.
11.o: As Hirata recovers and the class shows unity, it's finally Ayanokoji vs. Sakayanagi. The final special exam has begun and the first round is basketball. Class C puts up a good fight, but Sakayanagi plans to mentally shake Sudo so he will fall.

12.t: Change your desires rather than the order of the world.
12.o: The class narrowly lost to Class A in the final exam, and were demoted back to Class D. However, the students showed growth throughout the year. Horikita, in particular, having grown as leader requests to dissolve the alliance with Class B.

13.o: It's spring break. Shiina calls Ayanokoji to discuss books. Meanwhile, Class B's Kanzaki appears before Ryuen, who is having a secret meeting with Hashimoto. Although the class was defeated, Kanzaki faces Ryuen without hesitation.

1.o: Ayanokoji's second year begins with a new threat from the White Room and a new special test.

2.o: Ayanokoji and Horikita's quest for a partner for Sudo brings them to a first-year with unusual demands.

3.o: Class 2-D continues its negotiations with Class 1-D as the state of the field becomes more clear.

4.o: Negotiations with Hosen come to a head with little time left before the end of the special test.

5.o: Ayanokoji manages to avoid a scheme set up by the new first-year students that could have led to expulsion. However, the results of his special exam throw Class 2-D into an uproar, with some even suspecting foul play. Ayanokoji ends up being pressed by his classmates...

6.o: The uninhabited island survival exam for this year has been announced. It will last for two weeks, and the island will be larger than last year's. Additionally, students from all grade levels will compete against each other. Before the exam begins, a four-week period is provided for forming groups, sparking a fierce competition among all classes to recruit members.

7.o: The first-years arrange a super team for the upcoming test, but bad blood runs deep between Utomiya and Hosen.

8.t: The Subject of the Dragons' Gaze
8.o: With the test approaching, Ayanokoji attracts attention from third-years and Ryuen.

9.o: The deserted island special test finally begins.

10.o: The special test begins in earnest as Ayanokoji takes the state of the game and aids a struggling teammate.

11.o: After hearing the watch alarm, Ayanokoji and the others discover the first students to withdraw.

12.o: Ayanokoji and Nanase's latest journey takes them over the mountains, where dramatic revelations are made.

13.o: Amasawa confronts Ayanokoji and reveals her connection to the White Room.

14.o: The third-years make their move to try to dominate the test's top three slots.

15.o: The first-years make a big move to take down solo-team stragglers... starting with Ayanokoji!

16.o: While Amasawa delays Horikita, Ayanokoji arrives at the I2 area where a climactic showdown awaits.

1.o: After a long separation, Ethel and her husband John Reginald Christie set up home in 10 Rillington Place, but Ethel soon wonders whether she has made the right decision. As war breaks out, the fractures in their relationship begin to reappear, with deceit, suspicion and violence never far below the veneer of married respectability.

2.o: When newlyweds Tim and Beryl move into 10 Rillington Place, they are befriended by their older neighbours the Christies. As time passes and their relationship hits a rough patch, Mr Christie's interest and influence over the couple takes a much more sinister turn.

3.o: After the strain of Timothy Evans's trial, Christie finds it increasingly difficult to maintain the charade. As his marriage breaks down, he embarks upon a course of action which finally reveals his true nature to the world.

1.o: Gary McCullough, an entrepreneur in the middle of his four year struggle with drug addiction. We see how he ended up on the road to ruin after being a sucessful businessman. We meet his former wife Fran, who is raising thier two sons and dealing with her own addiction to drugs.

2.o: DeAndre is kicked out of the house by Fran for selling drugs, so he moves into the apartment that the family once lived in. He has a party with his friends and sex with Tyreeka as his father continues his habit. Gary even steals drugs from DeAndre as he is having sex with Tyreeka.

3.o: Fran decides to fight her drug addiction.

4.o: The series focuses more on Andre and his drug dealing lifestyle as he deals with police and the birth of his son.

5.o: Andre and his friends go about their business of slinging drugs as they try to stay out of jail.

6.o: Everyone's fates are reveal in this must watch final episode. Fran defeates her drug addiction as Gary deals with his. DeAndre deals with his drug selling and the final path it leads him on.

1.o: In 1930s Los Angeles. Jack Parsons works as a janitor at a chemical factory by day, but, by night, he nurses a secret ambition: to build rockets that will take mankind to the moon. The pressures of his double life are further complicated when Jack and his wife Susan are confronted by a mysterious new neighbor, Ernest Donovan, who appears to be leading a double life of his own.

2.o: After Professor Mesulam gives his blessing to the project, Jack and Richard set off to create Caltech's first ever rocketry team. But Caltech's acceptance has come with caveats, and, coupled with Ernest's looming presence, Jack and Susan are feeling more on edge than ever before, desperate to figure out whether Ernest's intentions are evil or not.

3.o: Feeling the pressure to succeed and provide Susan with the life he promised, Jack urges the rocketry team to take a risk and start testing their experiments at full volume. Sensing the Parsons' mounting frustrations, Ernest invites them to one of his group's secret gatherings, promising a way to make all their dreams come true.

4.o: Jack’s expert witness testimony at a high profile trial thrusts the rocketry team into the spotlight and helps land them a coveted invitation to The Athenaeum. Meanwhile, Virgil drops off Patty, Susan’s rebellious teenage sister, for a disruptive weekend stay, and Ernest’s wife, Maggie, makes a surprise return. When Jack’s evening at The Athenaeum doesn’t go as planned, Jack seeks out Ernest to blow off some steam and ends up on a dark detour into the Los Angeles underbelly.

5.o: The team finalizes their prototype but, in a role reversal, Richard has confidence in the design while Jack doubts it will work. Jack leaves the team to test fire without him as he and Susan accept Ernest and Maggie's invitation to go camping in Joshua Tree. While Susan gets better acquainted with Maggie, Ernest uses a mind-bending elixir to teach Jack about the power of Thelema.

6.t: The Mystic Circles of the Young Girls
6.o: A secret return visit to the Agape Lodge leaves Jack wanting more, inspiring him to explore new sexual boundaries at home with Susan, despite her misgivings. Ernest's sudden presence at the Rocketry Team's new desert testing facility has Richard questioning the whole endeavor, until he meets a mysterious woman who helps restore his faith. Meanwhile, Maggie has doubts about Ernest's fidelity.

7.o: While Richard and the rocketry team abandon the Suicide Club for more conventional pursuits, Jack delves deeper into the world of Thelema and Sex Magick as a means to convince General Braxton that reaching the moon isn't just comic book fantasy. Susan's concerns about Jack grow after she researches Aleister Crowley and confronts Maggie with the mysterious truths behind this cult religion. Susan's questions leave Maggie at a breaking point, forcing Ernest to confront his inner demons.

8.o: Susan's concerns about Jack grow after she researches Aleister Crowley and confronts Maggie with the mysterious truths behind this cult religion. Susan's questions leave Maggie at a breaking point, forcing Ernest to confront his inner demons.

9.o: Susan realizes Thelema might be the key to understanding her own psychological wounds. She attends the Agape Lodge for purge sessions with the Grand Magus, while Jack becomes increasingly disenchanted with the religion that promised so much yet delivered so little. Richard and the Suicide Club hit a massive stumbling block, forcing Richard to invite Jack and Susan out to a lavish dinner in an attempt to gain Jack's help. But Jack has been offered a promotion at Pueblo Powder and must decide between providing Susan with the life she always wanted or burying the hatchet with Richard to continue

10.o: When Jack receives a letter from Aleister Crowley, inviting him to ascend to the next degree, the Parsons must decide if Thelema is what they both want for their future. After uncovering the truth about Virgil during her purge sessions, Susan is forced to deal with the chilling revelation back in the real world. Richard and Jack finally find common ground, rallying the Suicide Club for a dangerous final demonstration to the military. For the demo, Jack has all he needs except for one crucial element: Ernest.

1.o: A duchess leads a group of high-society Madrid women to Melilla during the Rif War to open a hospital and nurse the wounded amid rough conditions.

2.o: Emotions runs high when Pilar and Luis find themselves stranded. An injured Cmdr. Silva is brought to the hospital, where Pedro accuses him of treason.

3.o: Julia, Larbi and Pedro face the consequences of their actions. While visiting Larbi's home, Magdalena is overwhelmed and alarmed by strong feelings.

4.o: Carmen's illness suddenly becomes life-threatening when she's caught in an ambush. Recovering in the hospital, Andrés's prison buddy recognizes Julia.

5.o: Magdalena writes Daniel a letter. Verónica pulls a stunt to get Pedro out of jail and in the OR. Julia and Susana await news of the rescue mission.

6.o: Pilar overhears Raquel making a confession to her father. The queen visits Melilla and decides Carmen's future. Fidel declares his feelings to Julia.

7.o: A mortally injured Román is found on the steps of the hospital. When Ahmed falls ill with meningitis, everyone in the hospital is quarantined.

8.o: A delirious Magdalena rambles on to Larbi. Fidel is permitted to open a field hospital at the front. An unusual new patient takes a fancy to Pilar.

9.o: Two deaths, including a nurse's, shatter the field hospital staff. Daniel behaves as if he never got Marga's letter. Alejandro tries to woo Pilar.

10.o: A captive Julia and Fidel spend a night together as if it were their last. Magdalena decides to return to Madrid. Verónica gets a surprise visitor.

11.o: Julia and Fidel are unable to keep their secret under wraps. Andrés suspects the army of financial corruption. In Madrid, Magdalena breaks her news.

12.o: Fidel is forced to choose between Julia and Susana. Magdalena decides her future, but faces an unforeseen consequence. Raquel delivers her baby.

13.o: Susana's mother tells a lie to keep Fidel in Melilla. Pain forces Carmen to undergo a biopsy, while postpartum fever leads Raquel to act dangerously.

1.o: Mia glumly arrives at a strange new boarding school where she immediately clashes with the popular girls. But she's given an amazing gift: a final birthday present from her father that draws her into a beautiful game world called Centopia. Transformed into an elf, Mia makes friends with Centopia's royalty and discovers she possesses a unique skill. However, when she clashes with the ruthless general Gargona and her unicorn-hunting army, she soon finds this world is no less difficult or dangerous than the one she left behind.

2.o: Mocked by Violetta for her embarrassing athletic performance, Mia yearns to retreat from school to the more idyllic land of Centopia. But this time, she has to solve a puzzle to figure out the password. Vincent, a fellow outsider, gives Mia the help she needs but nearly discovers her secret. In Centopia, Mia discovers Phuddle's dissonant Trumptus is more than meets the ear. Thanks to her help, the elves have a new reason to be hopeful.

3.o: Mocked by Violetta for her embarrassing athletic performance, Mia yearns to retreat from school to the more idyllic land of Centopia. But this time, she has to solve a puzzle to figure out the password. Vincent, a fellow outsider, gives Mia the help she needs but nearly discovers her secret. In Centopia, Mia discovers Phuddle's dissonant Trumptus is more than meets the ear. Thanks to her help, the elves have a new reason to be hopeful.

4.o: A scuffle with Violetta leaves Mia worried about having her secret exposed and Vincent frustrated with once again being left in the dark. The unusually grim oracle leads Mia to rescue Lyria in the Valley of Vapors, where she becomes lost - and in need of rescuing herself. Though Yuko and Mo find her in time, the invaluable Trumptus is left behind for Panthea to fulfill the ominous prophecy.

5.o: A quick-thinking Vincent helps Mia evade Violetta and her cronies, who are determined to get their hands on Mia's mysterious book. Still unsure if she can trust Vincent with the truth, Mia disappears to Centopia in time to find Lyria in need of urgent help. She also witnesses an amazing event: the birth of a golden-horned unicorn who may be the key to restoring hope to Centopia.

6.o: On a field trip to the museum, Mia and Vincent avoid Paula, the latest of Violetta's accomplices recruited to spy on Mia. When she finally escapes to Centopia, the excitement over Onchao's ability to restore dead lands and Trumptus pieces is short-lived when Lyria is taken captive by Gargona and her munculus army. A newly determined Mia vows to protect Onchao with all her might.

7.o: Still anxious about the tragic events of her last visit to Centopia, Mia can't concentrate on the things that matter, like schoolwork or her duty to her best friend Vincent. But in Centopia, she has another friend in need: Onchao. Now that Lyria's gone, he's bored, lonely and lost. Though Mia is desperate to cheer him up, she soon finds herself in a sticky situation and only the despondent Onchao can help.

8.o: Mia is less than enthusiastic about taking her first etiquette class, where she's scolded by the old-fashioned teacher and one-upped by the prim and proper Violetta at every turn. 7.o: After Ferrán gets on Pablo and Juan Carlo's nerves, they meet with a lawyer. Mariana helps Ceci plan a romantic night with Dario, to Ana's dismay.

8.o: When Pablo and Juan Carlos take legal action against Ana and Mariana, the women resort to an extreme solution to protect their families and business.

1.o: Pablo and Juan Carlos try to gather evidence to prove that Mariana and Ana are lying. Tere puts Victor to the test. Ferran tries to make Mariana jealous.

2.o: Ana and Mariana host a party to win new investors. Ferran and Mariana struggle to hide their relationship. Tere opens up to Mariana about her pregnancy.

3.o: Choosing a school for the girls causes trouble between Mariana and Ana. Juan Carlos needs Ana's help to become the president of his family's company.

4.o: Ana and Mariana have a car accident, which leads to an intimate encounter. Juan Carlos bumps into an old flame. Ceci makes a decision about her future.

5.o: Ana has a heart-to-heart with Mariana. Tere has a heated discussion with Victor's dad. Juan Carlos meets Fernanda's friends on a camping trip.

6.o: Ana goes on a date with another woman. Mariana moves in with Ferran. Pablo and Cynthia organize a dinner to deliver some very uncomfortable news.

7.o: Mariana finds out a big secret about Ferran's past. Ana's reunion with her father does not turn out as she expected. Ceci starts working at Rorros.

8.o: Ana runs into Juan Carlos at an ayahuasca ceremony. Mariana is offered a job outside the city. Ro asks Elena to help him woo his crush.

9.o: Ana and Pablo make a plan to prevent Mariana from leaving. Cynthia and Pablo consider moving in together. Tere gets tested to determine her baby's health.

10.o: Ana makes a decision and, with the help of Ceci and other accomplices, goes looking for Mariana before she leaves for Tijuana. Tere goes into labor.

1.o: Hae Won is sick and tired of living in this cold world. She comes home to Bukhyeon-ri, the rural village where she grew up, to heal her soul. Eun Seop sees that Hae Won, a classmate from high school, has returned and feels an odd surge of emotions. They meet again in the same place where they share memories from ten years ago.

2.o: Hae Won runs into Jang Woo, another classmate from high school while in town. He invites her to the small book club that meets in Eun Seop’s bookstore. It’s a small gathering of the townspeople that makes Hae Won feel warm inside. Meanwhile, Hae Won learns that Jang Woo gave her phone number to someone she really did not want to remember.

3.o: When Hae Won sees Bo Yeong, she is reminded of the pain she endured in high school. Meanwhile, a cold snap engulfs Bukhyeon-ri and the water pipes in Hodu House begin to burst one by one. Hae Won has no other choice but to stay with Eun Seop for the time being. When Eun Seop goes up to the mountains at night, Hae Won tries to find him.

4.t: My Old House in My Dream
4.o: Eun Seop says that he knows the mountains like the back of his hand and Hae Won begins to wonder about him. Meanwhile, Jang Woo’s colleague goes missing in the mountains. Everyone in the village asks for Eun Seop’s help. Seeing Eun Seop with his family after he descends the mountain a hero, Hae Won realizes how different he is from her.

5.o: Hae Won’s Mom, Myeong Ju, shows up in Bukhyeon-ri out of the blue. Hae Won feels uncomfortable and awkward around her mom and they end up saying some hurtful words to each other. Meanwhile, Eun Seop goes to see Bo Yeong after getting a call from her. Hae Won sees them together and gets the wrong idea.

6.o: Yeong Woo, the boy who had a crush on Hae Won in high school, shows up in town. Eun Seop is bothered by Yeong Woo’s presence since he is obviously here to see Hae Won. Meanwhile, Hae Won moves back to Hodu House and the three of them meet again at the Joint Reunion. What kind of feelings are they each hiding?

7.o: Hae Won tells Eun Seop that she likes him, but his reaction is not what she expected. After her very direct confession, Hae Won goes to ask Eun Seop about something at the bookstore. When she gets there, she meets Bo Yeong and becomes upset. Meanwhile, Eun Seop is sick but then disappears into the mountains in a trance-like state.

8.o: When Eun Seop disappears into the mountains again, Hae Won gets worried and sets out to find him. She finds him at the cottage he always goes to, but his attitude towards her is very blunt and icy. Hae Won thinks that is Eun Seop’s way of rejecting her feelings for him and things become awkward between them. Later on, they end up going on another hike.

9.t: The Secret of the Boy Who Hated Dung Beetles
9.o: Hae Won and Eun Seop share their first kiss on the top of the mountain. Although Hae Won now knows that Eun Seop likes her back, she is anxious that he might disappear. Meanwhile, after having dinner with Jang Woo and Mr. Park, they rush over to break up a fight in the marketplace. There, Hae Won hears a secret about Eun Seop she never knew before.

10.o: A stranger shows up in town and disrupts Hae Won and Eun Seop’s happiness. He seems to be the same man from the picture Eun Seop carries in his wallet. The man asks Eun Seop to come with him, bringing up the fact that they are blood relations. Even with the bookstore’s flea market event happening soon, Eun Seop feels the need to follow the man.

11.o: Eun Seop receives a phone call at the bookstore that leads to an impromptu trip to see the landlord with Hae Won. It becomes a chance for the two to fall deeper in love. Meanwhile, Yun Taek asks Myeong Yeo to send him the first line of her new novel. Myeong Yeo sends over a single line via fax that contains a shocking secret from the past.

12.o: Myeong Yeo fax puts Yun Taek in a frenzy and he calls Myeong Yeo all day long, even though she won’t pick up. Meanwhile, Hae Won remains oblivious of the truth from the past that is replaying in Myeong Yeo’s mind and continues to spend sweet moments with Eun Seop. However, Bo Yeong shows up at the bookstore unannounced one night.

13.o: Bo Yeong calls Eun Seop to come and save her in the mountains. Hae Won goes to get her instead and the two finally get to talk honestly. Meanwhile, Yun Taek runs to Myeong Yeo’s side after receiving a text message. He sees what Myeong Yeo has been hiding behind her sunglasses. Finally, Hae Won discovers Eun Seop’s secret diary.

14.o: Myeong Yeo is admitted to the hospital but refuses to get treatment. In an attempt to convince Myeong Yeo, Hae Won calls her mom. Meanwhile, Myeong Yeo sends the manuscript for her new book to Eun Seop and Yun Taek. Although it is supposed to be a mixture of fiction and non-fiction, the story seems a bit too truthful and personal.

15.o: Myeong Yeo declares that she wants to turn herself in to the police and that she has been suffering from guilt all this time. Hae Won is hurt and confused that she didn’t know about any of what happened. With winter passing by and spring just around the corner, Eun Seop must prepare to let Hae Won go.

16.o: Hae Won and Eun Seop go on with their own lives as if they have forgotten about the other. Meanwhile, Myeong Ju writes a letter to Hae Won, saying all the things she wasn’t able to say before. She also lets Hae Won know that Myeong Yeo will be leaving soon. Hae Won contemplates whether or not to go back to Bukhyeon-ri.

1.o: Jalal suspects his wife who always incites his jealousy, but being weak in character, he cannot confront her. One day, he mysteriously disappears, and she goes on to search for him.

2.o: Afaf is afraid that Midhat might get back with his ex-wife, so she decides to tie him up with a child. But when he gets promoted at his job and a new lady manager becomes in charge, Afaf gets jealous and uses her old trick. Now Afaf and Medhat have 6 kids.

3.o: Following their marriage, Shawky and Noha spend all their time looking for an apartment, but to no avail. Having no other choice but to live with Noha's family, trouble finds its way to the life of the couple.

4.o: When false news about Afifi's suicide spread, his wife decides to throw a party to prove the news false.

5.o: Khaled returns from abroad and he tries to reconnect with his ex-sweetheart who left him and married a famous doctor. He claims he just wants them to be friends.

6.o: Despite her mother's objection, Nesma marries Talaat who is much older than her. Nesma then finds herself in a critical situation when Nader returns from abroad and confesses his love for her.

7.o: Metwally wants to marry Badria, but his financial situation holds him back. Badria's mother tries to wed her to another man who is financially better off.

8.o: As Magdy's health deteriorates due to his anxiety and his excessive smoking, his wife starts to suspect him.

9.o: Fate brings Mu'nes and Safia to work together at the same school after ten years of separation. However, their different mindsets and viewpoints trigger many issues and stand in the way of forming a musical band at school.

10.o: Headmaster Mahrous decides to take his wife to Cairo, partially to see her doctor, and partially to visit her wealthy uncle.

1.o: Ma Eum has only six months to figure out what she really wants to pursue in her life now that she has decided to move on from judo. When she realizes that webtoons were what made it possible for her to endure hardship, she applies for a job at webtoon platforms, including Neon. As expected, her passion was not enough to land her a job. A few months later, after getting all her applications rejected, she gets a phone call from Neon.

2.o: An emergency breaks out at Ma Eum’s office, and it has something to do with her meeting with one of the artists earlier that day. Ji Hyeong and Ma Eum knock on his door, but he refuses to talk to them or let them in. At Ma Eum’s house, her mom is watching a documentary about David of Michelangelo, and this is where Ma Eum finds the solution to the problem. Meanwhile, Jun Yeong, Ma Eum’s colleague, is having trouble adapting to the team.

3.t: There’s No Paradise For You To Escape To
3.o: Ma Eum and Jun Yeong are assigned to their first webtoon artists. Ma Eum is assigned to one of her favourite artists, but she finds it difficult to control him. She needs to learn new ways to make the artist meet the deadlines, and things don't go as smoothly. Meanwhile, Jun Yeong asks his team leader to reassign him to another department, only to be rejected.

4.t: You Talented Ones Shall Be Slaves To Your Talents
4.o: Ma Eum succeeds in convincing her artist and gets her hard work and effort recognized. Thanks to her, the storyline of “Princess Kumiho” improves, helping the artist gain his fans back. Meanwhile, Jun Yeong is offered a shocking deal by Mr Heo, putting him in a pickle.

5.t: The Number Of People Needed To Support
5.o: Ma Eum recruits rookie artists through the Webtoon Camp, but helping their debut is more difficult than she thought. She has to convince Sin Dae Lyug to work more on his drawing skills and tell Goo Seul A to improve her storyboard. Despite her hard work, things don't turn out the way she wants them to. What's even worse is that her dad finds out she's working for a webtoon company instead of developing her judo skills.

6.o: Ma Eum finds out that Producer Kwon has been treating the newbie artist, Goo Seul A, in a harsh way. She confronts him at work, asking him to cut her some slack. Producer Kwon disregards Ma Eum's request, which makes her explode in the end. Later, Ma Eum learns about the painful backstory of her team and what Producer Kwon went through to become who he is today.

7.t: You're Like My Long Cherished Dream
7.o: Dong Hee feels inferior to Dae Lyug, who looks like a genius to him. Despite the ten years he spent working under Baek Eo Jin, he thinks that he's hit his limit. Ma Eum encourages him to continue pursuing his dream, but she is also reminded of herself who quit judo after years of trying. Meanwhile, Ji Hyeong spots Artist Na Gang Nam meeting with an assistant editor of Youngtoon.

8.t: I Will Be Your Unchanging Truth
8.o: Gang Nam contemplates about moving to another platform which would give him better treatments. However, he realizes that working with Neon would give him more memories about "Princess Kumiho", so he decides to extend his contract. Meanwhile, Ji Hyeong is offered a position in another webtoon company that shakes him up.

9.t: Don’t Let Your Fate Or Loneliness Defeat You
9.o: Man Chul and his colleagues visit the artist Ma Hae Kyu to persuade him so that they can publish a remake of a legendary cartoon as a webtoon. Ma Eum tries to care for his daughter since she hates her father. Artist Ma keeps considering the proposal. Meanwhile, the first episode of “Weapon Feeb” makes a hot shot debut.

10.o: Ji Hyeong gets confused after he got an offer as the chief editor of Youngtoon. Man Chul tells him to think about himself first. Ma Eum feels sad to hear the rumour as he was her first mentor. Finally, at the team dinner gathering, Ji Hyeong announces his decision on whether he’ll leave or stay.

11.o: Jun Yeong mistakenly thinks that Ji Hyeong and Man Chul are responsible for his sister’s death. He can’t decide whether to betray the team even further and hand over the materials he got from Young Bae to Director Heo. Ji Hyeong shares what happened to Jun Yeong’s sister to Ma Eum, and she finally understands Jun Yeong’s past actions.

12.o: The managing director of Neon gives the webtoon team one last chance to prove their place in the company. Chief Editor Jang gathers the whole team to encourage them to work with him for their final shot. However, Ma Eum witnesses Jun Yeong secretly meeting Director Heo.

13.t: Don’t Let Your Bad Luck Catch Up With You
13.o: Jun Yeong tells Ma Eum why he’s been seeing Director Heo separately. Ma Eum meets Director Shin with Dae Lyug to discuss the drama adaptation of “Weapon Feeb”. However, Dae Lyug runs away during the meeting out of trauma that Director Shin triggered. Meanwhile, Gang Nam shares big news with Ma Eum and Ji Hyeong.

14.o: Dae Lyug’s mother visits Neon, hoping to get his address. She ends up following Ma Eum to Dae Lyug’s place, and he panics at the sight of her. Someone uploads a malicious post about Dae Lyug, saying he molested a woman. Now Ma Eum has to deal with Dae Lyug’s mother and find evidence to prove the post wrong in order to help Dae Lyug with his artist’s block.

15.t: Go for It Head-on, and Let It Break You
15.o: Dae Lyug successfully submits and uploads the next episode of “Weapon Feeb,” thanks to everyone’s help. The long-awaited board meeting is held, keeping everyone on the Webtoon Team on their toes. Mr. Baek decides to take a long break and get an operation on his back. The webtoon team and Dae Lyug visit him after the operation, only to hear bad news.

16.o: Ma Eum and Producer Kwon choose the same webtoon artist again, and they must come up with proposals to win the artist’s heart. Jun Yeong thinks of the ways to confess his feelings for Ma Eum. Meanwhile, Man Chul receives an offer from Managing Director Yoon that he cannot resist.

20.o: Two days before Over the Limit, an unhinged John Laurinaitis pits the WWE Champion CM Punk in a match against Kane. Number one contender Daniel Bryan looks to gain momentum against Zack Ryder. World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus tangles with one of his Fatal 4-Way challengers, Randy Orton.

21.o: Empowered Executive Eve sets up a monster Triple Threat Match to determine the next No. 1 Contender for Sheamus' World Heavyweight Championship. Will Kane, Randy Orton, or Alberto Del Rio challenge for the title at No Way Out? Big Show continues to chastise the WWE Universe. Santino Marella settles his announcing squabble with Ricardo Rodriguez.

22.o: CM Punk defends his WWE Championship against Kane. Sheamus faces Dolph Ziggler, while The Prime Time Players are in tag team action against Santino Marella and Zack Ryder.

23.o: Nine days before their World Heavyweight Championship Match at No Way Out, Sheamus and Alberto Del Rio each must contend with some colassal competition in Kane and The Great Khali. And Friday nights are about to get funky as SmackDown snares its very own living, breathing Funkasaurus - Brodus Clay.

24.o: Big Show vents his frustrations with WWE, clearing the air regarding his accidental punch to Mr. McMahon and his disdain for John Cena. Will Cena send a message of his own to the disgruntled giant? Plus, tempers flare between World Champions CM Punk, Sheamus, and a pair of No. 1 Contenders leading to a tag team No Way Out preview.

25.o: Alberto Del Rio faces Christian. AJ is at ringside to witness Kane taking on Daniel Bryan. Dolph Ziggler gets another chance to prove he is worthy of a title opportunity when he faces The 'Great White', Sheamus.

26.o: Christian and Santino Marella team up against Cody Rhodes and David Otunga. AJ Lee goes one-on-one against Layla. Sheamus defends his World Heavyweight Championship against Dolph Ziggler and Alberto Del Rio in a Triple Threat main event.

27.o: Fourth of July festivities, Great American Bash-style, with Sgt. Slaughter and "Hacksaw" Jim Duggan.

28.o: World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus and Alberto Del Rio are in action just days before they finally meet one-on-one at Money in the Bank. Can they handle the respective challenges of Chris Jericho and Sin Cara? The Big Show faces The Great Khali, and Christian and Santino Marella square off against Dolph Ziggler and Cody Rhodes.

29.o: After nearly a year away, Rey Mysterio returns to SmackDown in his hometown of San Diego! What will the high-flying Superstar have in store for his nemesis, Alberto Del Rio and the new Mr. Money in the Bank, Dolph Ziggler? And on Christian's Peep Show, guests Daniel Bryan and AJ discuss their wedding plans for the 1000th Raw.

30.o: Coming off the historic Raw 1000th episode, four Superstars vie to become the No.1 contender to Sheamus's World Heavyweight Championship! Can the new Intercontinental Champion, The Miz, hold off the challenge of former champ Christian? Will Ryback's unbeaten streak continue?

31.o: Mr. McMahon reveals the new General Manager of SmackDown, who instantly shakes things up by bookending the night with two huge match-ups. World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus faces Tensai while his SummerSlam opponent Alberto Del Rio meets the recently returned Randy Orton.

32.o: Chris Jericho presents The Highlight Reel with guest Dolph Ziggler. Rey Mysterio takes on the Intercontinental Champion The Miz. With SummerSlam one week away, Alberto Del Rio have waited long enough and will challenge Sheamus for the World Heavyweight Championship in the main event.

33.o: Alberto Del Rio makes his case for Booker T to reinstate his World Heavyweight Championship opportunity. Chris Jericho is looking to build momentum before his showdown with Dolph Ziggler. And who will be Booker T's new assistant, Kaitlyn or Eve?

34.o: Alberto Del Rio and Randy Orton vie to be the No. 1 Contender for Sheamus' World Heavyweight Championship. The Celtic Warrior himself is in action against another Superstar with championship aspirations, "Mr. Money in the Bank" Dolph Ziggler. And Cody Rhodes continues his fixation on the mask of Sin Cara.

35.o: After an RKO cost Dolph Ziggler a chance at cashing in his Money in the Bank Contract last week, 'The Showoff' goes one on one with 'The Viper' Randy Orton. The 'Master of the 619' Rey Mysterio is in action against Cody Rhodes and Sheamus prepares to defend his World Heavyweight Championship at Night of Champions.

36.o: With Night of Champions approaching, will Sheamus' devastating Brogue Kick be banned when he defends his World Heavyweight Title against Alberto Del Rio? Three young and determined tag teams compete to for a chance to unseat the WWE Tag Team Champions. And Wade Barrett has returned seeking to launch a barrage through the SmackDown roster.

37.o: World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus engages in a WrestleMania rematch with Daniel Bryan. Will the Celtic Warrior have the same luck without the use of the banned Brogue Kick? Championship holders The Miz and Antonio Cesaro see action just 48 hours before putting the gold on the line. Plus, Randy Orton faces the dangerous Tensai.

38.o: In the wake of a controversial Night of Champions, WWE Hall of Famer Edge pays the WWE Universe a visit to weigh in on Daniel Bryan and Kane's struggle to forge their bizarre new championship alliance. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus teams with Randy Orton to face a pair of hopeful title contenders, Alberto Del Rio and Dolph Ziggler.

39.o: Randy Orton collides with the Big Show, for a chance to become the No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship. The SmackDown General Manager Booker T establishes a No. 1 Contender's Tag Team Tournament. Plus, Santino Marella faces Antonio Cesaro in a United States Championship Match and more.

40.o: Sheamus and Big Show have a heated conversation as they head towards Hell In A Cell. WWE Champion CM Punk is in action and more!

41.o: What will Randy Orton have in store for Alberto Del Rio? Also, weeks before their colossal encounter at Hell in a Cell, World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus and No. 1 Contender Big Show look for the psychological edge by proving which devastating finishing move packs more power: the Brogue Kick or the Weapon of Mass Destruction.

42.o: World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus goes toe-to-toe against the Barrett Barrage in a star-studded Lumberjack Match. Will the Lumberjacks be enough to keep Big Show at bay? After returning to SmackDown last week, 'The Viper', Randy Orton, faces the most must-see Superstar in WWE History, The Miz.

43.o: Just two days away from Hell in a Cell, tensions rise between the World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus and the No. 1 Contender, The Big Show. Team Hell No and Team Rhodes Scholars face each other in separate singles matches before their Tag Team Championship Match at Hell in a Cell. Plus, Randy Orton is in action against Wade Barrett and more!

44.o: In the aftermath of Hell in a Cell, The Miz hosts another controversial installment of MizTV with his guest, the former World Heavyweight Champion, Sheamus. The 'Master of the 619' goes head-to-head with Titus O'Neil, The 'Punjabi Prince' faces off against the Harvard-educated David Otunga, and much more.

45.o: Randy Orton and Alberto Del Rio's rivalry continues to explode as they brawl all over the arena in a Falls Count Anywhere Match. Plus, Big Show & Wade Barrett team up to face Sheamus & William Regal, The Miz challenges Kofi Kingston for the Intercontinental Championship, and more.

46.o: With Survivor Series just 48 hours away, the eclectic members of Team Foley and Team Ziggler attempt to get on the same page. Sheamus is bent on getting his hands on Big Show before their scheduled rematch for the World Heavyweight Championship on Sunday. Meanwhile, Big Show faces another colossal confrontation in the ring from a mystery opponent.

47.o: It's the night after Thanksgiving, but the Superstars of SmackDown are still hungry for a feast. Randy Orton, faces off against Dolph Ziggler. World Heavyweight Champion Big Show has his giant hands full in a Handicap Match against Team Hell No. And John Cena addresses the WWE Universe for the first time since his shocking kiss with AJ Lee on Raw.

48.o: Sheamus faces Dolph Ziggler, but with an angry Big Show in the building and John Cena returning to SmackDown for the second week in a row, will all these combustible elements explode? Also in action, the Intercontinental Champion Kofi Kingston & Tag Team Champions Team Hell No take on Wade Barrett & The Prime Time Players.

49.o: The Shield and Team Hell No attempt to gain an edge heading into their Six-Man Tables, Ladders & Chairs Match at WWE TLC. Big Show and Sheamus are in action, but can the rivals last nine days without brutalizing each other before their Chairs Match for the World Heavyweight Championship? Plus, Randy Orton takes on Wade Barrett.

50.o: Just 48 hours before facing Sheamus in a Chairs Match at WWE Tables, Ladders & Chairs, what manipulative tactics will Big Show use to keep his World Heavyweight Championship? Who will be The Shield's next victim as they build momentum toward their clash with Ryback and Team Hell No? Plus, Kofi Kingston, Alberto Del Rio, Antonio Cesaro, and more.

51.o: AJ Lee addresses her shocking actions at WWE TLC, as well as her association with Dolph Ziggler and massive newcomer Big E Langston. Ryback issues a challenge to WWE Champion CM Punk for the start of 2013, and John Cena and Sheamus team up for a tag team main event vs Ziggler and World Heavyweight Champion Big Show.

52.o: In the final SmackDown of 2012, Big Show defends his World Heavyweight Championship, but who will be the challenger after a bizarre turn of events? Dolph Ziggler takes on The Miz with AJ Lee and Big E Langston by his side. Brad Maddox has one more chance to earn an elusive WWE contract, but he must defeat The Celtic Warrior Sheamus.

1.o: SmackDown rings in the new year with the return of Randy Orton! And with the upcoming Royal Rumble on his mind, The 'Viper' teams with Sheamus against two reigning champions, Big Show and Antonio Cesaro. Plus, Kofi Kingston gets a chance for a rematch againt the man who took his Intercontinental Championship, Wade Barrett.

2.o: FINALLY...The Rock comes back to SmackDown for the first time in 10 years! What will 'The People's Champ' have to say in response to CM Punk's comments? Plus, General Manager Booker T kicks off the new year with a major bombshell affecting the main event match between World Heavyweight Champion Big Show and Albert Del Rio.

3.o: It's the 700th episode of SmackDown! Alberto Del Rio kicks off his new championship reign with a fiesta of grand proportions. But when rivals crash the party, the turmoil leads to a massive Tag Team main event. Plus, Team Hell No teams with Randy Orton for one night in a Six-Man Tag Team Match against Wade Barrett & Team Rhodes Scholars.

4.o: Two days before his Royal Rumble clash with The Rock, CM Punk calls out The Shield to address their potential involvement. Will The Rock show up after sustaining a brutal attack on Raw? Plus, Booker T sets up a massive Six Man Tag Team Match that includes World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio and his Royal Rumble challenger, Big Show.

5.o: SmackDown Superstars make their case for the upcoming Elimination Chamber Match. World Champion Alberto Del Rio is determined to get his hands on Big Show. The high flying duo of Rey Mysterio and Sin Cara reunite for a match against the bickering Team Hell No. And a former World Heavyweight Champion returns to SmackDown.

6.o: The quest for the Elimination Chamber continues on SmackDown! The rivalry between Big Show and Alberto Del Rio heats up. Cody Rhodes takes on Kofi Kingston. Can Team Hell No continue to co-exist or will their relationship go up in flames? Mark Henry takes on Randy Orton and much more.

7.o: The Road to WrestleMania becomes more dangerous with the Elimination Chamber in two days. What will The Rock have to say about CM Punk's theft of the WWE Championship? A fuming Big Show faces Chris Jericho as he prepares to challenge Alberto Del Rio. Plus, Randy Orton faces another Chamber participant, the massive Mark Henry.

8.o: The Superstars of WWE aim to build momentum on the road to WrestleMania. Fresh off a monumental pay-per-view win, new #1 contender Jack Swagger faces a man still holding a grudge from Elimination Chamber, Randy Orton. World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio squares off with Intercontinental Champion Wade Barrett.

9.o: Randy Orton may have kicked the hornets nest known as The Shield, but he may have a much larger problem when he goes one-on-one with Big Show. Hall of Famer Jim Ross attempts to get to the bottom of Jack Swagger's transformation. And the rivalry over the United States Championship between Antonio Cesaro and The Miz reaches new heights.

10.o: World Champion Alberto Del Rio faces Dolph Ziggler. Sheamus and Big Show square off as The Shield waits in the wings. And will this be the week the WWE finally witnesses the in-ring debut of Fandango?

11.o: SmackDown kicks off with a big Tag Team Match when Randy Orton joins forces with Sheamus to take on Team Rhodes Scholars. Dolph Ziggler goes one-on-one with Kane. The Shield's reign of terror continues. Jack Swagger takes on Chris Jericho. Mark Henry, Ryback, and more.

12.o: Days after breaking Ricardo Rodriguez's ankle on Raw, 'The Real American' Jack Swagger faces Chris Jericho. The Miz takes on Antonio Cesaro. And with Ryback fighting his own battles, can Sheamus and Randy Orton trust Big Show in their clash against The Shield at WrestleMania?

13.o: The Rock has come back to SmackDown! What will the WWE Champion say to John Cena with his WrestleMania showdown merely nine days away? The WrestleMania team of Sheamus, Randy Orton & Big Show put their newfound chemistry to the test in preparation for The Shield. Plus, Ryback and Mark Henry show off their strength in a bench press challenge.

14.o: JBL and Michael Cole host the final SmackDown before WrestleMania, live from WrestleMania Axxess. Ryback tunes up for his epic WrestleMania clash with Mark Henry by competing in a Handicap Match. Jack Swagger squares off with Kofi Kingston looking to gain some momentum heading into his World Heavyweight Champion Match at WrestleMania.

15.o: In his first appearance since cashing in the Money in the Bank Contract the night after WrestleMania, Dolph Ziggler celebrates becoming the new World Heavyweight Champion. Triple H addresses the WWE Universe after his monumental WrestleMania win. And after targeting Undertaker on Raw, where will The Shield strike next?

16.o: Sheamus and Randy Orton team up to face the massive duo of Big Show and Mark Henry. Alberto Del Rio battles through an ankle injury to take on rival Jack Swagger. And new United States Champion Kofi Kingston goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Wade Barrett.

17.o: From London, England, The Undertaker returns for his first match on SmackDown in nearly three years against The Shield's Dean Ambrose. Alberto Del Rio and Jack Swagger continue their brutal rivalry in a No Disqualification Match. Plus, Sheamus faces Big Show and Randy Orton goes one-on-one with the 'World's Strongest Man' Mark Henry.

18.o: Kane seeks to inflict hellacious revenge on The Shield when he faces Dean Ambrose one on one. We find out who is stronger when Sheamus and Mark Henry compete in an Arm Wrestling Contest. Plus, Daniel Bryan takes on Ryback.

19.o: With Extreme Rules just one week from Sunday, Ryback has a major appetite for destruction on Chris Jericho's Highlight Reel. The 'World's Strongest Man', Mark Henry attempts to break a world record by pulling two tractor trailers and a heated confrontation between Team Hell No and The Shield leads to a match between Dean Ambrose and Daniel Bryan.

20.o: In the final SmackDown before WWE goes extreme, The Miz stirs the pot between Extreme Rules opponents, Randy Orton and Big Show on Miz TV. Plus, with the World Heavyweight Champion Dolph Ziggler sidelined, how will the two contenders to his title attempt to settle their score?

21.o: At Extreme Rules, all three Shield members claimed championship gold. Now on SmackDown, Kofi Kingston gets his rematch with Dean Ambrose for the United States Title. Big Show faces off against Chris Jericho. And what can the WWE Universe expect from the new 'Paul Heyman' guy, Curtis Axel?

22.o: The recent dominance of The Shield has driven Team Hell No to the brink of extinction. Now, its divide and conquer time when Kane, Daniel Bryan and the 'Apex Predator' Randy Orton take on each member of the 'Hounds of Justice' in singles action. Plus, who is the next victim in Ryback's path of destruction?

23.o: Chris Jericho gears up for his clash with CM Punk at WWE Payback by trying to neutralize the newest Paul Heyman guy, Curtis Axel. Team Hell No and Randy Orton attempt to hash out their issues on MizTV. And Sheamus answers another 'Intellectual Challenge' from Damien Sandow.

24.o: Recently returned World Champion Dolph Ziggler and cohort Big E Langston face Alberto Del Rio and Chris Jericho with Ziggler and Del Rio's title match just two days away at Payback. And with their status as a team in a flux, can Team Hell No and Randy Orton work together to finally hand The Shield their first loss?

25.o: After an momentous night at WWE Payback, three new champions are in action on SmackDown. he new World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio takes on Chris Jericho. The new Intercontinental Champion Curtis Axel faces Wade Barrett and the new Divas Champ AJ Lee battles Natalya. Plus, tension grow between Randy Orton and Daniel Bryan.

26.o: It's 'Fiesta Del Rio' on SmackDown, as the World Champion celebrates his recent victory, but will former champ Dolph Ziggler crash the party? The Miz asks Paul Heyman the tough questions about Brock Lesnar and CM Punk. And Sheamus attempts to settle the score with Damien Sandow in a Dublin Street Fight.

27.o: CM Punk returns to SmackDown as he vies for his third career Money in the Bank Contract in the Money in the Bank All-Stars Ladder Match. Dolph Ziggler gears up for his World Heavyweight Championship rematch against Alberto Del Rio. Plus, Randy Orton and Christian renew a long-standing rivalry.

28.o: Money in the Bank competitors Randy Orton, Sheamus, Daniel Bryan and more try to gain the upper hand before scaling the ladders of destiny in just two days. Dolph Ziggler pulls out all the stops to send a message to Alberto Del Rio. Divas AJ Lee and Kaitlyn solidify plans for their championship clash on Sunday.

29.o: Randy Orton is on a hot streak following his Money in the Bank victory as he faces World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio. Daniel Bryan squares off against Wade Barrett, while Rob Van Dam returns to SmackDown. Damien Sandow and Cody Rhodes address their issues with one another following their Money in the Bank Ladder Match.

30.o: For the first time ever, World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio faces RVD. Money in the Bank winners Randy Orton and Damien Sandow square off, while Sandow's Money In the Bank contract is stolen by Cody Rhodes. CM Punk addresses Paul Heyman's actions while Dolph Ziggler interrupts Diva Champion AJ Lee's 'State of Her Mind Address'.

31.o: World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio chooses his opponent for SummerSlam. CM Punk is in action against Fandango, while Kaitlyn and AJ renew their bitter rivalry for the WWE Divas Championship. And how will Damien Sandow respond to seeing his Money in the Bank briefcase sink into the Gulf of Mexico?

32.o: RVD faces 'The Viper' Randy Orton. World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio is in action against Christian. Plus, major announcements and stipulations are made for the biggest event of the summer, SummerSlam. Dolph Ziggler and Kaitlyn interrupt AJ Lee and Big E Langston's appearance on Miz TV.

33.o: Big Show joins Mark Henry and RVD in a Tag Team match against The Shield. Daniel Bryan is in action against Wade Barrett, and this time, anything goes. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio, Christian, Kane, The Wyatt Family, and more seek the upper hand leading into the annual summer spectacular SummerSlam.

34.o: SummerSlam may be over, but the Superstars of WWE still feel the heat on SmackDown. Daniel Bryan looks for retribution after being robbed of the WWE Title by Randy Orton, but Vickie Guerrero has other plans. Alberto Del Rio gets back in the ring with Christian. Dolph Ziggler takes on Big E Langston, and more.

35.o: Dolph Ziggler and Big Show break their silence on Miz TV, with regard to Triple H's leadership. Plus, Daniel Bryan and Rob Van Dam gear up for their respective championship matches at Night of Champions. Curtis Axel praises the courage of his manager Paul Heyman.

36.o: WWE COO Triple H holds a town hall meeting to address the controversial firing of Cody Rhodes on RAW. With the locker room on edge, should the Triple H prepare for a backlash or will the WWE Superstars fall in line? Plus, WWE Champion Randy Orton, Daniel Bryan, Rob Van Dam, Big Show and more gear up for Night of Champions.

37.o: Big Show deals with the repercussions of defying Triple Hon RAW. Before the Night of Champions pay-per-view on Sunday, Daniel Bryan and Randy Orton exchange verbal jabs on The Cutting Edge. Paul Heyman has one last plea, and Dolph Ziggler tries to earn an opportunity to compete at the championship spectacular.

38.o: Daniel Bryan addresses the controversy surrounding his 'quick count' victory at Night of Champions. Vickie Guerrero schedules the Superstar supporters of Daniel Bryan in an 11-on-3 Gauntlet Handicap match. Plus, Ryback is in action for the first time with Paul Heyman by his side, and matches are made for the new pay-per-view event WWE Battleground.

39.o: The Miz, Big Show and others feel the impact of Triple H's leadership, though the COO insists his decisions are what is 'best for business'. World Heavyweight Champion Alberto Del Rio is in action. The United States Title is on the line when Dean Ambrose defends against Dolph Ziggler.

40.o: With WWE Battleground just days away, what is Daniel Bryan's condition after being brutally attack by Randy Orton? Triple H puts Big Show in a 3-on-1 Handicap match against The Shield, and The Game might have another surprise for the tormented giant. Plus, Alberto Del Rio and Rob Van Dam tune up for their World Heavyweight Championship Match.

41.o: SmackDown GM Vickie Guerrero updates the WWE Universe on Triple H's condition following Big Show's actions on RAW. The WWE and World Heavyweight Championship scenes take shape for the Hell in a Cell pay-per-view. A family rivalry breaks out between the newly rehired Rhodes brothers and the Wyatts.

42.o: Cody Rhodes and Goldust have their first contest as the new WWE Tag Team Champions. CM Punk faces Big E Langston. The Wyatts and much more.

43.o: With only two days left until their Hell in a Cell match for the vacated WWE Championship, No. 1 Contenders Daniel Bryan & Randy Orton compete in a massive 8-Man Tag Team main event. WWE COO Triple H responds to the turmoil the Big Show has caused while Ryback and Paul Heyman tune up for CM Punk. Also, Alberto Del Rio has a message for John Cena.

44.o: John Cena returns to SmackDown! The Usos take on The Shield in a tag team showdown and the Miz invites WWE Hall of Famer Shawn Michaels on MizTV to talk about the controversial WWE Championship match at Hell in a Cell. All this and more.

45.o: With Survivor Series quickly approaching, who will challenge John Cena for the World Heavyweight Championship? And after weeks of heinous attacks, CM Punk responds to The Wyatt Family, and Daniel Bryan faces Luke Harper one-on-one. Plus, R-Truth and The Usos team up against 3MB, while Divas Champion AJ Lee & Tamina Snuka take on The Funkadactyls.

46.o: CM Punk & Daniel Bryan keep their newfound alliance intact when they battle Ryback & Curtis Axel. The Wyatt Family takes on The Usos. After a vicious assault on John Cena's healing arm on Raw, Alberto Del Rio challenges Cena to an arm wrestling contest. Will The Champ accept? All this and more.

47.o: Rey Mysterio returns to SmackDown for the first time in nearly a year to team with The Usos against one of the most dominant trios in history, The Shield. Daniel Bryan follows the buzzards to face The Wyatt Family's Luke Harper. And the Rhodes brothers, Cody Rhodes and Goldust, defend their WWE Tag Team Championships against The Real Americans.

48.o: Randy Orton vows to defeat John Cena in a Tables, Ladders and Chairs Match and become both the World Heavyweight Champion and WWE Champion. Plus, with a Handicap Match against all three members of The Shield looming, CM Punk competes against the Hounds of Justice in a 12-Man Tag Team main event.

49.o: WWE Champion Randy Orton battles Daniel Bryan while making his case for being the greatest Superstar of any generation. The Shield's Dean Ambrose takes on CM Punk. The Real Americans pick a fight with Rey Mysterio and a partner of his choosing. Natalya battles Tamina.

50.o: After the Championship Ascension Ceremony turned to chaos on Raw, Randy Orton attempts to make amends with The Authority on SmackDown while John Cena delivers a message to The Viper. CM Punk's issue with the Shield continues while Daniel Bryan's rivalry rages on against the Wyatts Family.

51.o: Coming off a tooth and nail battle with Daniel Bryan on Raw, Randy Orton addresses his reign as the inaugural WWE World Heavyweight Champion. How will The 'Viper' cope with a giant bullseye now firmly placed on his back? Plus, a star-studded team unites to face The Shield. The Rhodes Brothers take on the Wyatt Family.

52.o: In the final SmackDown of 2013, John Cena is fired up and ready to close out the year with a bang. Will he get his wish for a rematch with WWE World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton? Plus, the 2013 Superstar of the Year Daniel Bryan is in action against Damien Sandow. The Shield is looking for a fight. Who will step up to the Hounds of Justice?

1.o: The disunity between Shane McMahon and Daniel Bryan came to the forefront during AJ Styles' main event showdown against Sami Zayn, leading to a huge Royal Rumble WWE Title Match announcement.
