2.o: Shane McMahon put Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn against a wall when he scheduled them in a 3-on-2 Handicap Match against WWE Champion AJ Styles, Shinsuke Nakamura and Randy Orton. However, the challenges presented by the Commissioner wouldn’t stop there for The “Yep!” Movement.

3.o: In an impromptu main event, the Final of the United States Championship Tournament went down when Jinder Mahal took on Bobby Roode after each qualified earlier in the night. Elsewhere, the women of Team Blue continued to slug it out as the first-ever Women’s Royal Rumble draws near.

4.o: Feeling backed into a corner, WWE Champion AJ Styles found himself in another jam when he agreed to take on both Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn in back-to-back singles matches on SmackDown LIVE. Elsewhere, the Team Blue women threw down in a wild melee just five days before the first-ever Women’s Royal Rumble Match.

5.o: With their WWE Title Match at WrestleMania now official, WWE Champion AJ Styles & Shinsuke Nakamura teamed up against Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn on SmackDown LIVE. The one rub? Owens & Zayn were informed beforehand that they would be squaring off against one another next week, with the opportunity to be the next challenger for Styles’ WWE Championship at WWE Fastlane on the line.

6.o: Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn’s one-on-one encounter to determine a challenger for WWE Champion AJ Styles at WWE Fastlane took a chaotic turn, leading to Daniel Bryan throwing all three a curveball. Elsewhere, United States Champion Bobby Roode defended his title against Rusev.

7.o: Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn tried to take control of their own destiny by ambushing Dolph Ziggler and Baron Corbin before their match to see who would advance to the WWE Title Match alongside them and WWE Champion AJ Styles at WWE Fastlane. However, their plan would ultimately backfire when SmackDown LIVE Commissioner Shane McMahon flipped the script and gave both Ziggler and Corbin a chance to advance, potentially making it a Fatal-5 Way Match for the title at WWE Fastlane.

8.o: With the WWE Championship Fatal 5-Way Match at WWE Fastlane coming into focus, WWE Champion AJ Styles took on Baron Corbin in non-title competition, and Kevin Owens squared off against Dolph Ziggler, with Sami Zayn playing a pivotal role in both bouts.

9.o: John Cena arrived on SmackDown LIVE with a clear plan to move forward to WrestleMania, setting his sights on the WWE Title Match at WWE Fastlane. Elsewhere, Shane McMahon and Daniel Bryan continued to clash over Bryan’s handling of Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn.

10.o: The one-on-one main event between WWE Champion AJ Styles and Dolph Ziggler took an unexpected turn after The “Yep!” Movement injected themselves with a surprise attack. Elsewhere, Randy Orton and Jinder Mahal rekindled their epic rivalry, as United States Champion Bobby Roode watched on from the announce desk.

11.o: After announcing he'd be taking an indefinite leave of absence from his position, SmackDown LIVE Commissioner Shane McMahon delivered on his promise to make a major WrestleMania announcement, but the plan backfired on him when Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn were not happy with what they heard. Elsewhere, matters intensified between WWE Champion AJ Styles and Shinsuke Nakamura, as their WWE Title Match at WrestleMania 34 draws closer.

12.o: On one of the biggest nights of his life, SmackDown LIVE General Manager Daniel Bryan spoke emotionally about once again being cleared to compete in WWE. When he fired Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn later in the night, however, his celebration turned upside down, as he suffered a brutal assault at the hands of The "Yep!" Movement.

13.o: Shinsuke Nakamura took on Shelton Benjamin in the main event of SmackDown LIVE, with WWE Champion AJ Styles in The King of Strong Style’s corner at the Royal Rumble Winner’s behest. Elsewhere, SmackDown LIVE General Manager Daniel Bryan laid down a once unthinkable challenge to Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn for WrestleMania.

14.o: WWE Champion AJ Styles & Shinsuke Nakamura teamed up against Shelton Benjamin & Chad Gable, but did their mutual respect last through one final SmackDown LIVE prior to their WrestleMania 34 dream match? Elsewhere, Shane McMahon returned to SmackDown LIVE… and so did Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn.

15.o: In the wake of WrestleMania, Team Blue saw the dawning of a new era, as Shane McMahon made Paige the new General Manager of SmackDown LIVE. Then, in a fantasy match of Paige's creation, WWE Champion AJ Styles battled Daniel Bryan, a showdown that would fall victim to the wrath of The King of Strong Style. Plus, Carmella cashed in her Money in the Bank contract to become the new SmackDown Women’s Champion after the debuting IIconics laid waste to Charlotte Flair.

16.o: AJ Styles & Daniel Bryan formed a fantasy team as they took on Rusev & Aiden English, but Shinsuke Nakamura and the newest SmackDown LIVE Superstar Big Cass made sure to make their presence felt. Elsewhere, SmackDown Women’s Champion Carmella’s ’Mellabration was unceremoniously interrupted several times, including one interjection from the division’s newest threat.

17.o: In a huge Six-Man Tag Team Match main event, AJ Styles reunited with Karl Anderson & Luke Gallows to take on Shinsuke Nakamura, Rusev & Aiden English. Elsewhere, Big Cass’ disdain for Daniel Bryan grew to new heights, which would prove to have a major impact on WWE Backlash.

18.o: Two super-teams squared off as Charlotte Flair teamed with Asuka & Becky Lynch to take on SmackDown Women’s Champion Carmella and The IIconics in a memorable main event. Elsewhere, the tension between WWE Champion AJ Styles and Shinsuke Nakamura continued to mount, with a major stipulation being added to their title match at WWE Backlash.

19.o: WWE Money in the Bank was the focus of every blue brand Superstar, as three competitors qualified for the Money in the Bank Ladder Matches. Elsewhere, the growing beef between The New Day and The Bar continued.

20.o: WWE Champion AJ Styles and Shinsuke Nakamura collided in London’s O2 Arena with the winner getting the opportunity to pick the stipulation for their title match at WWE Money in the Bank. Elsewhere, two more Superstars claimed their place in the Money in the Bank Ladder Matches, and Big Cass finally pushed Daniel Bryan past his limit.

21.o: Daniel Bryan took on U.S. Champion Jeff Hardy for the first time, with a Men's Money in the Bank Qualifying Match against Samoa Joe hanging in the balance. Plus, Lana and Naomi both qualified for the Women's Money in the Bank Ladder Match, and Luke Gallows & Karl Anderson earned an opportunity to battle SmackDown Tag Team Champions The Bludgeon Brothers on June 17.

22.o: In a shocking turn of events, a Triple Threat Match between Daniel Bryan, Samoa Joe and Big Cass was announced as the final Men’s Money in the Bank Qualifying Match. Elsewhere, The New Day and The Bar squared off in a major Six-Man Tag Team Match.

23.o: With WWE Money in the Bank momentum being the theme of the night, all of SmackDown’s participants in the Men’s Ladder Match did battle, as The New Day squared off against The Miz, Rusev and Samoa Joe in Six-Man Tag Team action. Elsewhere, Charlotte Flair took on Becky Lynch, and Jimmy Uso & Naomi faced Lana & Aiden English.

24.o: In a thrilling 10-Woman Tag Team Match main event, Asuka made a massive statement heading into WWE Money in the Bank when she defeated SmackDown Women’s Champion Carmella just five days before their title match in Chicago, literally putting all eyes of the SmackDown LIVE Women’s division on her.

25.o: Rusev won a star-studded Gauntlet Match to earn the right to challenge WWE Champion AJ Styles at WWE Extreme Rules. Elsewhere, SAnitY made an unforgettable debut and left an immediate impression.

26.o: Just when it looked like Daniel Bryan was going to take another bludgeoning at the hands of The Bludgeon Brothers, Kane returned to come to the aid of his friend, and the ever-memorable Team Hell No reunited. He and Bryan cleared the ring of Harper & Rowan and got some major news from SmackDown LIVE General Manager Paige regarding WWE Extreme Rules.

27.o: Feeling as though Team Hell No was not worthy of their SmackDown Tag Team Championship opportunity at WWE Extreme Rules, The Usos challenged Daniel Bryan & Kane in the main event. If Jimmy & Jey won, they would be added to Bryan & Kane’s championship bout against The Bludgeon Brothers.

28.o: After an absolutely wild brawl between the united Team Hell No & The New Day against The Bludgeon Brothers & SAnitY to kick off the show, the two super teams squared off in an epic 5-on-5 Tag Team Match in the main event just five days before WWE Extreme Rules.

29.o: In the wake of WWE Extreme Rules, Randy Orton interrupted the heated rematch between newly-crowned United States Champion Shinsuke Nakamura and Jeff Hardy to lay waste to The Charismatic Enigma.

30.o: Daniel Bryan attempted to crash the party celebrating The Miz & Maryse’s new reality show “Miz & Mrs.,” but The A-Lister would stoop to an all-time new low to get the jump on The “Yes!” Man.

31.o: Charlotte Flair returned to SmackDown LIVE to come to the aid of her friend Becky Lynch after she was assaulted by SmackDown Women’s Champion Carmella, but The Queen quickly found herself in the thick of a higher stakes scenario with major SummerSlam implications.

32.o: The New Day squared off against The Bar with the opportunity to face The Bludgeon Brothers for the SmackDown Tag Team Championship at SummerSlam hanging in the balance. Elsewhere, the tension continued to boil over between The Miz and Daniel Bryan.

33.o: WWE Champion AJ Styles arrived at SmackDown LIVE hoping to break out of his vicious mental cycle caused by Samoa Joe over the past several weeks, but his SummerSlam challenger had one last trick up his sleeve that may have driven The Phenomenal One off the deep end just five days before their title clash at The Biggest Event of Summer.

34.o: The Bludgeon Brothers and The New Day squared off in a hard-hitting and explosive No Disqualification rematch from SummerSlam with the SmackDown Tag Team Titles on the line. Elsewhere, tempers boiled over further between Daniel Bryan and The Miz in a way that no one could have possibly seen coming.

35.o: Charlotte Flair might have repelled the challenge of Carmella in a thrilling SmackDown Women’s Championship main event, but she could not escape an Irish Lass Kicking from her former best friend, Becky Lynch, who challenged The Queen to a title clash at the WWE Hell in a Cell pay-per-view event on Sunday, Sept. 16!

36.o: On a whirlwind SmackDown LIVE, Daniel Bryan & Brie Bella thwarted an attack from Andrade “Cien” Almas & Zelina Vega in order to send a strong message to their WWE Hell in a Cell opponents The Miz & Maryse. Plus, Rusev Day earned the right to face The Bar next week to establish The New Day's SmackDown Tag Team Championship opponents at the Sept. 16 pay-per-view, WWE Champion AJ Styles attacked Samoa Joe, and SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair engaged in a war of wars with Becky Lynch.

37.o: Brie Bella and Maryse’s one-on-one showdown quickly turned into a chaotic brawl when Daniel Bryan and The Miz got involved. Elsewhere, WWE Champion AJ Styles and Samoa Joe delivered personal messages to each other ahead of their title clash this Sunday at the WWE Hell in a Cell pay-per-view event.

38.o: In the wake of WWE Hell in a Cell, newly-crowned SmackDown Women's Champion Becky Lynch unleashed a vicious attack on Charlotte Flair during her SmackDown Women’s Championship Coronation. Plus, Shinsuke Nakamura battled The Bulgarian Brute for the U.S. Title on Rusev Day, and Samoa Joe and AJ Styles continued throw fists in a post-match collision.

39.o: Samoa Joe took his conflict with WWE Champion AJ Styles to the next level when he delivered on his promise from several weeks ago by showing up at Styles’ family home in Georgia while The Phenomenal One was thousands of miles away in Denver. Elsewhere, The Miz and R-Truth clashed over the rights to “Miz TV” … sort-of.

40.o: Poised for WWE Super Show-Down in Melbourne, Australia, the blue brand descended into all-out chaos as Charlotte Flair hurled SmackDown Women’s Champion Becky Lynch through her own custom poster, Randy Orton injured Tye Dillinger’s finger in the turnbuckle and The Bar served up SmackDown Tag Team Champions The New Day.

41.o: Randy Orton squared off against the returning Big Show in a WWE World Cup Qualifying Match that pushed both Superstars to their limits. Elsewhere, Becky Lynch and Charlotte Flair saw their saga take a devastating turn as they faced off in a WWE Super Show-Down title rematch.

42.o: An absolutely loaded SmackDown 1000 saw Rey Mysterio make an unbelievable return to the blue brand, cameos from Mr. McMahon, Batista, Ric Flair and Edge, as well as The Big Show making a catastrophic impact on the SmackDown Tag Team division.

43.o: Randy Orton and Jeff Hardy rekindled their rivalry with another barbaric encounter on the blue brand. Elsewhere, the footage from the wild brawl between SmackDown Women’s Champion Becky Lynch and Charlotte Flair at the WWE Performance Center was finally revealed.

44.o: During an unpredictable SmackDown LIVE, Jeff Hardy & Rey Mysterio took on Randy Orton & The Miz ahead of their scheduled clashes in the WWE World Cup, but The Viper went the extra mile to dismantle his fellow tournament entrants as they all aim to be named the best in the world. Elsewhere, WWE Crown Jewel came early, as WWE Champion AJ Styles defended the title against Daniel Bryan with Samoa Joe lurking in the wings.

45.o: The blue brand began to put its Survivor Series teams together for the battle for brand supremacy against Raw at WWE’s Survivor Series, but it soon became obvious that there could be a few bumps in the road with Daniel Bryan and The Miz co-captaining the men’s team.

46.o: In one of the most shocking SmackDown LIVE episodes of all time, Daniel Bryan stunned the WWE Universe in his WWE Championship Match against AJ Styles, and Becky Lynch made a very surprising decision regarding her replacement to face Ronda Rousey this Sunday at Survivor Series.

47.o: Rey Mysterio and Randy Orton’s main event match took a horrifying turn when The Viper sadistically targeted The Biggest Little Man after the bell. Elsewhere, Charlotte Flair and Daniel Bryan addressed their surprising actions over the past week.

48.o: Asuka won a Battle Royal to secure her place in the SmackDown Women’s Championship TLC Match against Becky Lynch and Charlotte Flair at WWE TLC: Tables, Ladders & Chairs. Elsewhere, Rey Mysterio and Randy Orton engaged in a wild brawl one week after The Viper stole Mysterio’s mask.

49.o: Two weeks from WWE TLC, AJ Styles’ pursuit of the “New” Daniel Bryan led him into a showdown with The Miz. Plus, Samoa Joe continued to antagonize Jeff Hardy, and the contract signing for the first-ever Women’s Triple Threat TLC Match resulted in a reluctant tag team partnership between Charlotte Flair & Asuka.

50.o: The WrestleMania rematch between Charlotte Flair and Asuka ended when The Queen bashed The Empress of Tomorrow with a kendo stick, but that was only the start of SmackDown LIVE's chaotic conclusion. Though she took the first blow, it was Asuka who stood tall at the end, battering both Flair and SmackDown Women's Champion Becky Lynch with the kendo stick. Was this a preview of what lies ahead for all three women in this Sunday's Tables, Ladders & Chairs Match?

51.o: In one of the biggest upsets in SmackDown LIVE history, Mustafa Ali got the best of “The New” Daniel Bryan when the newest SmackDown LIVE Superstar teamed up with AJ Styles to take on the WWE Champion & Andrade “Cien” Almas in a major main event on the blue brand.

52.o: What was a festive Christmas night edition of SmackDown LIVE took a shocking turn when AJ Styles met with WWE Chairman Mr. McMahon, who said he wanted to see the “animal” inside The Phenomenal One. A slap from The Chairman to Styles’ face did the trick, as the former WWE Champion struck Mr. McMahon with a thunderous right hand. Also, a new United States Champion was crowned and “The New” Daniel Bryan continued to run roughshod over anyone in his path.

1.o: On a monumental New Year’s Day SmackDown LIVE, AJ Styles unleashed the newfound aggression he showed Mr. McMahon last week on four other Superstars en route to earning a WWE Championship Match against “The New” Daniel Bryan at Royal Rumble. Plus, John Cena came face to face with The Man in his return to Team Blue.

2.o: Becky Lynch, Charlotte Flair and Carmella squared off in a Triple Threat Match to determine who would challenge SmackDown Women’s Champion Asuka at Royal Rumble. Elsewhere, WWE Champion “The New” Daniel Bryan felt pressure from all sides as his recent actions began to come back and haunt him.

3.o: When The Bar crashed The Miz’s “Bestie Birthday Bash” for Shane McMahon, it led to an impromptu match between Miz and Sheamus that saw The Bar covered in cake. Elsewhere, SmackDown Women’s Champion Asuka and Becky Lynch attempted to one-up each other as their Royal Rumble title clash approaches.

4.o: Rey Mysterio and Andrade brought the house down in another instant classic, this time a 2-out-of-3 Falls Match, but Samoa Joe and Randy Orton stole some headlines by match’s end. Elsewhere, the issues between SmackDown Women’s Champion Asuka, Becky Lynch and Charlotte Flair intensified as all three look to dominate at the Royal Rumble event this Sunday.

5.o: WWE Champion “The New” Daniel Bryan looked to evade every single threat to his title on SmackDown LIVE, but he instead received news that he would have to face five of them inside the dreaded Elimination Chamber in three weeks. Elsewhere, Becky Lynch and Charlotte Flair got into a wild brawl.

6.o: ”The New” Daniel Bryan and Jeff Hardy squared off in the main event of SmackDown LIVE, but all six WWE Title Elimination Chamber Match participants couldn’t help but get involved by the end of the bout. Elsewhere, Becky Lynch confronted a McMahon Family member for the second consecutive night, going face-to-face with Triple H.

7.o: A highly competitive Gauntlet Match determined who would be last to enter the WWE Championship Elimination Chamber Match this Sunday, a bout that now also has a new entrant. Elsewhere, Charlotte Flair spoke with elation on being chosen to replace Becky Lynch against Raw Women’s Champion Ronda Rousey at WrestleMania 35.

8.o: Following a huge Six-Man Tag Team Match, the challenger for “The New” Daniel Bryan’s WWE Championship at WWE Fastlane was revealed. Elsewhere, NXT Superstars continued to shine bright as Tommaso Ciampa, Johnny Gargano, Aleister Black and Ricochet brought their best to the blue brand.

9.o: Mr. McMahon dropped a bombshell when he announced that Kevin Owens would replace Kofi Kingston as “The New” Daniel Bryan’s challenger for the WWE Championship at WWE Fastlane. However, matters complicated even more when the returning Owens suggested that he and Kingston team up against Bryan & Rowan in the main event of SmackDown LIVE.

10.o: Charlotte Flair personally invited Becky Lynch to SmackDown LIVE and matters quickly turned physical between the two WWE Fastlane opponents. Also, tension between WWE Champion “The New” Daniel Bryan and Kevin Owens reached a fever pitch as their title clash approaches this Sunday.

11.o: Kofi Kingston’s WWE Championship opportunity future was decided when Mr. McMahon made a major announcement regarding what The Dreadlocked Dynamo would have to do to face off against Daniel Bryan at WrestleMania. Elsewhere, Shane McMahon held nothing back in his explanation of why he betrayed The Miz at WWE Fastlane.

12.o: Kofi Kingston attempted to secure his place in the WWE Championship Match at WrestleMania, but just when he thought he was en route to The Grandest Stage of Them All, Mr. McMahon dropped a bombshell that would completely change The Dreadlocked Dynamo’s road to the title yet again.

13.o: After New Day threatened to quit WWE, Mr. McMahon gave Kofi Kingston one last chance to challenge for the WWE Title at WrestleMania … except his fate wouldn’t be in his hands. The Chairman decreed that if Kofi’s New Day brethren could prevail in a Tag Team Gauntlet Match, then The Dreadlocked Dynamo would get his WWE Championship Match on The Grandest Stage of Them All.

14.o: WWE Champion “The New” Daniel Bryan railed on Kofi Kingston’s good name one too many times, as a passionate Kofi finally lashed out verbally just five days before challenging The Planet’s Champion for the title on The Grandest Stage of Them All.

15.o: Kofi Kingston’s WWE Championship celebration was cut short when The Bar & Drew McIntyre crashed the party, challenging The New Day to a Six-Man Tag Team Match in the main event of SmackDown LIVE. Elsewhere, The Usos and The Hardy Boyz battled for the SmackDown Tag Team Titles, but the winners would not be able to enjoy the victory, as Lars Sullivan emerged to wreak havoc.

16.o: Night Two of the Superstar Shake-up seen on SmackDown LIVE with many surprises that include the arrivals of Roman Reigns, Finn Bálor, Bayley, Ember Moon and many more. Elsewhere, The New Day appoints a new honorary member of the group after appearing on “The Kevin Owens Show.”

17.o: It seemed the makeshift New Day of WWE Champion Kofi Kingston, Xavier Woods and Kevin Owens was flourishing … but then the newly dubbed “Big O” shocked the WWE Universe with a jaw-dropping attack. Elsewhere, Roman Reigns faced steep repercussions for his Superman Punch to Mr. McMahon.

18.o: The dilemma between The New Day and Kevin Owens intensified, as Owens continued to target WWE Champion Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods. Elsewhere, the SmackDown LIVE representative’s in the Men’s and Women’s Money in the Bank Matches were announced.

19.o: The “Wild Card Rule” brought Raw’s AJ Styles and Sami Zayn to SmackDown LIVE, but WWE Champion Kofi Kingston upped the ante when he challenged both Superstars to a Triple Threat Match with WWE’s most prestigious prize on the line. Elsewhere, new SmackDown Tag Team Champions were crowned, but not in the way Shane McMahon intended when the “Wild Card Rule” struck again.

20.o: With WWE Champion Kofi Kingston as the scheduled guest on “The Kevin Owens Show,” it seemed likely that the two WWE Money in the Bank opponents would trade blows only five nights before their WWE Title Match … which they did, but no one could have predicted how it materialized, thanks to Mr. McMahon’s Wild Card Rule.

21.o: Roman Reigns took on Elias in a Money in the Bank rematch, with it clear that Shane McMahon would be doing everything in his power to slow The Big Dog down prior to WWE Super ShowDown … including using the Wild Card Rule to his advantage. Elsewhere, Big E returned to SmackDown LIVE … but so did Dolph Ziggler, and he made it clear he is coming for WWE Champion Kofi Kingston.

22.o: R-Truth’s journey as 24/7 Champion took another interesting turn when he accidentally interrupted Shane McMahon Appreciation Night. The mishap briefly cost him the 24/7 Title, but Truth’s fortunes changed when he teamed with Roman Reigns to take on Elias & Drew McIntyre in the blue brand main event.

23.o: Goldberg’s first-ever appearance on SmackDown LIVE brought the WWE Universe even more than they bargained for when his WWE Super ShowDown opponent The Undertaker arrived to create a one-of-a-kind moment. Elsewhere, WWE Champion Kofi Kingston and Dolph Ziggler mixed it up prior to their title match in Jeddah.

24.o: With Big E finally being cleared for in-ring competition, The New Day brought their best to the trio of Dolph Ziggler, Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn in the SmackDown LIVE main event. Elsewhere, Shane McMahon attempted to make an example out of The Miz as his Super ShowDown victory tour continued.

25.o: WWE Champion Kofi Kingston & Universal Champion Seth Rollins teamed up to take on Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn in a blockbuster 2-out-of-3 Falls Match main event on SmackDown LIVE. Elsewhere, the growing tension between SmackDown Women’s Champion Bayley and Alexa Bliss finally boiled over in a tumultuous “Moment of Bliss” that would see fists fly.

26.o: WWE Champion Kofi Kingston and Dolph Ziggler amazed the WWE Universe with an incredible 2-out-of-3 Falls Match, wherein The Showoff could earn his way into the WWE Title Match at Extreme Rules with a win. Elsewhere, another 2-out-of-3 Falls bout took centerstage as The Miz squared off against Elias.

27.o: After a chaotic set of circumstances, Kevin Owens & Dolph Ziggler collided with Heavy Machinery, and the winning team would earn their way into the SmackDown Tag Team Championship Match at WWE Extreme Rules. Elsewhere, Samoa Joe made a chilling proposition to Kofi Kingston, but the WWE Champion would not blink in the face of The Samoan Submission Machine.

28.o: Kevin Owens finally exploded on Shane McMahon, verbally assaulting The Best in the World at the start of the night and dropping him with a Stunner at the end of it, massively altering the main event between Roman Reigns and Dolph Ziggler.

29.o: The beef between Kevin Owens and Shane McMahon continued, first with Shane-O-Mac’s Town Hall Meeting quickly going south when KO abruptly arrived and then again in the main event when Owens tussled with Dolph Ziggler, but the conclusion would be altered when Shane hit the scene with some backup clearly aiming to take KO out.

30.o: Shane McMahon thought he had backed Kevin Owens and Roman Reigns into a corner when he pitted the two in a match against one another, as Drew McIntyre, Elias and Shane were all present for it. However, the tides quickly turned on “The Best in the World” when Owens and Reigns made it clear that they were more interested in tussling with Shane-O-Mac and company than each other.

31.o: Tonight on SmackDown LIVE, WWE Champion Kofi Kingston overcame United States Champion AJ Styles in a non-title Champion vs. Champion Match with the members of The O.C. and The New Day at ringside. Plus, Roman Reigns was denied the opportunity to make a SummerSlam challenge when a pile of scaffold and metal fell down upon him, and Charlotte Flair emerged to challenge Trish Stratus to a match at The Biggest Event of the Summer.

32.o: “The New” Daniel Bryan & Rowan made a statement at the conclusion of their tag team main event against Xavier Woods & Big E, and Roman Reigns got some information out of Buddy Murphy, who implicated Rowan as the culprit in his recent misfortunes.

33.o: The New Day engaged in a drag-out battle with Randy Orton & The Revival in a major Six-Man Tag Team main event on SmackDown LIVE, but the makeshift trio’s victory over the WWE Champion and SmackDown Tag Team Champions was only half the story. Also, the mystery surrounding who is responsible for the recent attacks on Roman Reigns took several more twists and turns.

34.o: ”The New” Daniel Bryan & Erick Rowan reveal who they believed to be the culprit behind the series of attacks on Roman Reigns – a man with almost identical facial features to Erick Rowan. Elsewhere, the WWE Champion Kofi Kingston proved he would not back down in the face of Randy Orton’s onslaught towards him and his New Day brothers.

35.o: Roman Reigns finally got the answer he was looking for when he confirmed that Erick Rowan was indeed responsible for attacking him. The reveal set “The New” Daniel Bryan into a frenzy, exploding on Rowan and attempting to explain to The Big Dog that he had no knowledge of Erick’s motives … but Reigns wasn’t exactly having it.

36.o: Erick Rowan brutalized both Roman Reigns and Daniel Bryan, firmly admitting to being Reigns’ attacker and then seemingly cutting ties from his former friend Bryan when he decimated him and viciously put him through a table.

37.o: Shane McMahon thought he had it all figured out when he inserted himself into the King of the Ring Tournament Semifinals against Chad Gable and appointed Kevin Owens as the special guest referee with promises of lifting Owens’ $100,000 fine. However, Gable wouldn’t quit in the face of Shane-O-Mac, prompting Shane to fire KO.

38.o: In the wake of WWE Clash of Champions, the reunited Erick Rowan & Luke Harper took out Daniel Bryan and Roman Reigns in an all-out destructive assault. Plus, Brock Lesnar made a surprise return to challenge WWE Champion Kofi Kingston to a title match at the FOX Friday Night SmackDown premiere on Oct. 4, and Chad Gable left King Corbin’s coronation in shambles.

39.o: Shane McMahon’s attempt to resolve Kevin Owens’ lawsuit resulted in KO challenging Shane-O-Mac to a high-stakes Ladder Match with each of their WWE futures on the line. Elsewhere, Roman Reigns & Daniel Bryan came together in their attempts to vanquish Erick Rowan & Luke Harper.

40.o: Kofi Kingston’s incredible journey as WWE Champion came crashing to a screeching halt when Brock Lesnar defeated him in mere seconds to win the title, however Lesnar’s night would take an unexpected turn when Rey Mysterio arrived with a blast from The Beast’s past in Cain Velasquez.

41.o: Bayley arrived on Friday Night SmackDown with a new look and new demeanor, but she left Las Vegas as the new SmackDown Women’s Champion after withstanding Charlotte Flair’s best to regain the coveted title. The WWE Draft also got underway with Raw and Friday Night SmackDown both bolstering their rosters with major talent acquisitions.

42.o: Following King Corbin’s interference in the Intercontinental Title Match between Shinsuke Nakamura and Roman Reigns that incited Daniel Bryan to come to The Big Dog’s aid, Bryan and Reigns teamed up to take on Corbin & The King of Strong Style in an unexpected main event on Friday Night SmackDown.

43.o: With Hulk Hogan and Ric Flair watching from ringside, members of Team Hogan and Team Flair collided in the main event of Friday Night SmackDown when Roman Reigns, Shorty G & Ali clashed with Intercontinental Champion Shinsuke Nakamura, King Corbin and Cesaro in a massive Six-Man Tag Team Match.

44.o: Adam Cole defended the NXT Championship against Daniel Bryan in an instant classic to conclude a night of surprises as the black-and-gold brand claimed a resounding victory over SmackDown in the first battle on the march toward Survivor Series.

45.o: Roman Reigns and Baron Corbin collided in Manchester, England, but The Big Dog would ultimately have to deal with a lot more than just The King of the Ring by match’s end. Also, Tyson Fury and Braun Strowman came face-to-face yet again in a WWE ring, this time with a potentially even more shocking conclusion.

46.o: During an appearance on “Miz TV,” Daniel Bryan’s verbal altercation with Bray Wyatt and the Firefly Fun House leads to a Universal Championship showdown at Survivor Series. Plus, as the battle for brand superiority at Survivor Series draws closer, NXT continued to knock at the door of the blue brand.

47.o: The battle for brand supremacy took several final shocking twists on Friday Night SmackDown, including appearances by Rhea Ripley, The Undisputed ERA, Seth Rollins and Triple H’s NXT army, which literally arrived ready for war.

48.o: SmackDown ended in unsettling fashion with “The Fiend” Bray Wyatt dragging Daniel Bryan underneath the ring. Elsewhere, The Big Dog sent an emphatic message to King Corbin, and The New Day defended the SmackDown Tag Team Titles in an open challenge.

49.o: Roman Reigns prevailed over Dolph Ziggler in the main event of Friday Night SmackDown, but The Big Dog got more than he bargained for when King Corbin & Ziggler handcuffed Reigns to the ring post and proceeded with one of the most humiliating attacks in WWE history.

50.o: On the final Friday Night SmackDown before WWE TLC, an “unchained” Roman Reigns lays waste to everyone in sight as he prepares to battle King Corbin in a Tables, Ladders & Chairs Match. Plus, the characters of the Firefly Fun House come out to play with The Miz’s daughter, Monroe.

51.o: On a special holiday edition of Friday Night SmackDown, the unlikely team of Daniel Bryan & The Miz teamed up against King Corbin & Dolph Ziggler, Heavy Machinery overcame The Revival in a Miracle on 34th Street Fight, Sasha Banks drew the ire of Lacey Evans when she taunted her daughter at ringside, and much more.

52.o: Following several twists and turns, Daniel Bryan prevailed in a Triple Threat Match against both The Miz and King Corbin to earn another opportunity at "The Fiend" Bray Wyatt's Universal Title at Royal Rumble next month. Following Bryan’s victory, however, Wyatt immediately appeared with an ominous question for his next challenger.

1.o: A main event pitting Daniel Bryan & Roman Reigns against King Corbin & Dolph Ziggler saw “The Fiend” Bray Wyatt emerge to target Bryan as well as the return of The Usos, who came to the aid of their cousin to close out a newsworthy Friday Night SmackDown. Also, Sheamus returned to ruthlessly ambush Shorty G, and John Morrison was spotted entering The Miz’s locker room.

2.o: The Usos’ first match back on Friday Night SmackDown against King Corbin & Dolph Ziggler took several shocking turns, but none more so than the one that resulted in Roman Reigns & The Usos laid out cold in a heap by night’s end.

1.o: The Shili Tai Fire and Rescue Station is in a festive scene. Suddenly the alarm rang, and firefighters were dispatched immediately. In the early morning, ER doctor Xu Qin had just returned from the emergency room after a major operation. A few firefighters covered in mud rushed in, begging her to treat his comrade who has a toothache. When she told the man to remove his mask, the man turned away and left the emergency room.

2.o: Song Yan was called to the Captain's Office. The team received complaints. Thanks to the persuasion from the staff officer, Song Yan got out of the siege. In the locker room, several colleagues were talking about Xu Qin, and it was rumored that she was the next person to be promoted. It was said that Xu Qin's family had an unusual background, and her colleagues were stunned. Xu Qin encountered a traffic accident on the way off from work, Xu Qin stopped immediately and prepared to enter the scene.

3.o: Song Yan came back from a mission and couldn't find the lighter, he ran to the garbage station to look for it. Song Yan told Suo Jun that the two had broken up due to family issues. Suo Jun comforted him. Xu Qin and Meng Yanchen came to the bar opened by Xiao Yixiao. After hearing that the fire department came to do a fire inspection, Xu Qin thought she could see Song Yan and ran out immediately. Seeing that Song Yan was not the one who came to check, Xu Qin felt depressed.

4.t: I Still Have You in My Heart
4.o: Xu Qin learned that Song Yan was on vacation. So she came to his aunt's house again, hoping to reconcile with him. Song Yan refused. In the fire station, Song Yan complained to Suo Jun about the poor performance of the recruits. Song Yan firmly believed that he and Suo Jun could turn Shili Tai into the best fire station in the country. Suo Jun dodged his eyes.

5.o: The driver who caused the accident surived, but the HIV-positive result of the blood test made everyone break out in a cold sweat. Not only were the doctors and nurses involved in the rescue at risk of infection, but the firefighters involved in the rescue that day were more likely to be infected. Xu Qin called the fire station, and all firefighters who participated in the rescue and were injured had to be checked. Xu Qin was worried and drew blood for Song Yan.

6.o: Xu Qin was awakened by knocking on the door. It turned out a child's hand was stuck in the anti-theft fence of the balcony upstairs. Song Yan led the firefighters to launch a rescue from the balcony of Xu Qin's house. The child was saved. After the firefighters completed their task and extracted, Song Yan turned back, which surprised Xu Qin.

7.o: Song Yan mistakenly thought it was his younger sister who came to bring him clothes and went out immediately. When the other firefighters heard that it was the female doctor Song Yan knows, they couldn't help but hide behind and peek. Xu Qin asked Song Yan to invite her to dinner, Song Yan reluctantly agreed. The two prepared for the date and came to a fried chicken shop they used to visit in high school. Time brings the two back to ten years ago.

8.o: Suo Jun told Song Yan about his difficulty, and Song Yan finally understood why Suo Jun wanted to be transferred. Suo Jun also advised Song Yan to get married soon. The two settled their suspicions. Looking at the honors of the fire station and listened to the thanks of the girl he saved, he tore up the transfer application he had written.

9.o: Fu Wenying learns that Xu Qin doesn’t go on a date because of her busy work, and needs her to change her job. Xu Qin confesses that she has someone she likes. Fu Wenying warns Xu Qin not to force herself to be a villain again.

10.o: Due to her mother's strict discipline, Xu Qin hasn’t dared to disobey her mother since she was a child. Although she is independent now, she is still stressed and afraid of facing her mother. She asks Song Yan to come out. Song Yan already knows she is in a dilemma before she speaks. Therefore, Song Yan agrees to go back to  square one.

11.o: Xu Qin speaks her mind to Meng Yanchen. She thinks she has been like a tame beast since she was a kid so she didn't dare to resist her mother and also doesn’t know what love is. Meng Yanchen proposes to her to go abroad with him but she refuses.

12.o: In order to speed up the replacement of old teammates and new blood, Jiang Yu proposes an idea to Song Yan but he disagrees with him. Song Yan thinks a fire scene is extremely dangerous and the new blood don’t have enough experience so they only are the reserves. Jiang Yu just wishes to avoid more meaningless sacrifices between the firefighters.

13.o: Meng Yanchen finds Xu Qin in the hospital, and he meets Song Yan by chance. He warns Song Yan to keep his distance from Xu Qin. Song Yan understands what he means and tells him not to interfere with Xu Qin’s life since he is not her biological brother. Meng Yanchen advises her not to end the relationship with her family because of Song Yan.

14.o: Since Xu Qin is reluctant to go on the blind date arranged by her mother, she arranges for the parents of both parties to meet. Xu Qin tells Jiang Yu that she has a crush on a man. He promises to help her.

15.o: A few college backpackers are stuck in a mountain and needed rescuing. Even the local civilian rescue team goes missing after looking for them. Without knowing the exact location, the firefighters face a tough rescue with the weather conditions and terrain. Meanwhile, Xu Qin receives a lesson on reading patients, not just treating them.

16.t: Setting Up a Joint Rescue Team
16.o: Shilitai Fire and Rescue Station proposes a joint rescue effort with the city's First People's Hospital. Xu Qin volunteers to join the training. At the fire station, both firefighters and medical staff learn from one another to improve the efficiency and efficacy of rescue operations.

17.o: After a bus flips over, a passenger named Chen Yu rescues many people before the firefighters arrive, but he is thrown out of the bus when it falls off a cliff and is seriously injured. He is called a hero by everyone, but he has an unknown side to him. Meanwhile, after the rescue, reporters want to interview Song Yan, but he introduces Xu Qin as the rescue team leader and gives the opportunity to her instead.

18.o: Jiang Yu and Li Meng went to a fire scene for a second inspection, but found some problems. The person in charge of the warehouse called a group of hooligans to beat them up but the firefighters can't fight or talk back, so they felt down in the dumps. Song Yan figured out a way to resolve their grievances, and they trained even harder.

19.o: Wu Xuan Yang calls 119 to rescue him and his alpaca, but Dr. Xu discovers that he has a serious condition called aortic dissection. His family doubts Dr. Xu's diagnosis but ends up being thankful to her for saving him. Meanwhile, Song Yan and Xu Qin exchange gifts with one another.

20.o: Xu Qin's mom discovers about Xu Qin staying the fire station. She goes to Song Yan to tell him to stop seeing Xu Qin. However, Xu Qin tries to rekindle with Song Yan who shuts her down in return. Later, they get into an argument about the mission of public servants.

21.o: With the medical staff gone from the fire station, Song Yan misses Xu Qin even though he refuses to admit it. However, a fire drill at the hospital reunites them again. Meanwhile, Dr. Xu contemplates her profession.

22.o: Teams are organized to help with the disaster rescue of earthquake victims in Wangxiang. The place is in bad shape, with many collapsed houses and structures and missing people. That includes Jiang Yi's mom, who's in Wangxiang with her sister, Jiang Yi's aunt.

23.o: Meng Yan Chen's mom wants her son and husband to let people know about the help they've been giving to disaster relief. Meanwhile, Song Yan and Xu Qin are both exhausted from the disaster rescue. Then, Song Yan gets seriously injured.

24.o: Despite knowing Song Yan's life is in danger, Xu Qin chooses not to stay by his side and continues fulfilling her duty as a doctor. The firefighters continue doing their mission in earthquake relief. Later, Xu Qin and Jiang Yi receive news that put their mind at ease.

25.o: After the successful disaster relief operation, Song Yan and Xu Qin go back to their lives. However, they can't continue setting aside their feelings for each other anymore. Things are beginning to fall into place, even in Dr. Xu's work.

26.o: Some firefighters struggle to get over their traumatic experience after providing the disaster relief at Wangxiang and are forced to overcome their anxiety by Yang Chi. Xu Qin is annoyed that Song Yan doesn't contact her for a day and doubts their relationship.

27.o: Meng Yan Chen finds out that Song Yan and Xu Qin are back together and tries to discourage Song Yan from being with her. He feels like he's been abandoned since Xu Qin went to find her happiness. Meanwhile, Xu Qin has learned to appreciate the process even if there might be no good outcome.

28.o: Xu Qin confesses to her parents that she is dating Song Yan who highly disapprove of their relationship. As a result, she moves out from home into Song Yan's. His aunt and uncle welcome her happily.

29.o: Xu Qin is welcomed warmly in the home of Song Yan's uncle and aunt. Xu Qin wants Meng Yan Chen to speak to their mom for her, but he refuses. Meanwhile, things seem to be progressing between Meng Yan Chen and Ye Zi.

30.o: Yan Chen tries to persuade his mom to let Xu Qin live her life, btu she doesn't back down. She invites Xu Qin to go shopping with her as a pretense to introduce her to another guy. Later, a mother and son threatens to jump off the hospital building Xu Qin works at.

31.o: There's a cyanide leak at an electroplating plant. Firefighters are dispatched to save the three workers who have been poisoned and resolve the issue. However, Song Yan also gets poisoned during the process.

32.o: Song Yan tells Xu Qin his future plans for them. Everyone is busy preparing and celebrating New Year, but the firefighters are still on duty to protect people. Xu Qin also goes home to visit her family for New Year.

33.o: Xu Qin is having a difficult time because her mom is interfering with her work at the hospital. Meanwhile, Song Yan is preparing for his transfer. However, a huge fire breaks out with a flashover that endangers the firefighters' lives.

34.o: A life is lost in the fire at Junguang Square, which is owned by Guokun Group. Song Yan has to decide whether to report about the truth of the fire which caused a death of his comrade. However, that decision will sow more discord between him and Xu Qin's family.

35.o: Song Yan is being suspended from work due to accusations of bribery. A new development in Shilitai Fire and Rescue Station also makes Song Yan's decision to transfer waver. And Xu Qin starts asking for explanations of things that happened in the past.

36.o: A patient at the hospital gets worked up and injures Xu Qin's wrist. Meanwhile, despite being in an argument over his past, Song Yan still does not want to tell Xu Qin how he got his gunshot wound. Zhai Miao is worried for him and goes to see Xu Qin to help patch up their relationship.

37.o: Xu Qin finds out what her family did to Song Yan and confronts her parents. Meanwhile, Meng Yan Chen frankly tells Ye Zi his thoughts about her and makes her angry. So she comes up with a plan to take revenge on him.

38.o: Zhai Miao holds the evidence to prove Yan Chen's innocence. The choice is in her hands whether to give it up and help the Meng family that ruined Song Yan's life, or do the same and destroy the Meng family.

39.o: Song Yan and Xu Qin are busy working with little time to prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, a super typhoon makes landfall in Yancheng and causes many people to be trapped or injured. Both the firefighters and medical staff have their hands full to help the people of Yancheng.

40.o: A typhoon causes disasters in the city. Floods and fallen trees slow down Xu Qin and Song Yan from rescuing civilians. At this moment, Mrs. Meng is trapped in her car under a collapsing tunnel. Will rescuers get to her in time?

1.o: 17 year old Tupac Shakur navigates school, poverty and family, while dreaming of using poetry and music to spread the message of his mother, noted Black Panther activist Afeni Shakur. Haunted by her past, Afeni fears how it will affect Tupac's future.

2.o: Tupac bursts onto the scene in both music and the movies, but trying to be a mainstream star and militant activist comes at a cost. Afeni’s activism lands her and her Panther comrades in a political show trial that could end with all of them in prison.

3.o: Tupac’s legal troubles escalate, with multiple different arrests, culminating in his being charged with sexual assault in New York. Afeni is the voice of the New York Panther 21, defending herself at trial; the two trials have different results.

4.o: Tupac spends nearly a year at the Clinton Correctional Facility at Dannemora. He leaves hardened by the experience and immediately joins Death Row Records.

5.o: After attending a Tyson fight in Las Vegas, Tupac is shot and killed. Afeni is paralyzed with grief after the death of her son. She manages to secure Tupac's legacy.

1.o: When Alex doesn't return from a family game of hide-and-seek, secrets are revealed about the Vanderhouvens' past, present, and future.

2.o: Pandora, Russ, and Sky befriend two unlikely allies—Stanley and Larry—while racing against time to capture a creature on the loose in the manor.

3.o: The Vanderhouvens leave home to search for answers about a cursed artifact from the Congo. But upon arrival, they face unexpected mayhem.

4.o: When three fertility statues come to life, it's up to Russ, Pandora, and Sky to reunite them with their “mother” on display at the Paxton Museum.

5.o: The Vanderhouvens discover a possible way to contact Alex. But chaos ensues—and Stanley gets caught in the center of it.

6.o: Russ, Sky, Stanley, and Larry navigate a new crisis after Pandora is sucked into a work of art and surrounded by sinister spirits.

7.o: The Vanderhouvens travel to a stormy Scottish island and cross paths with a puzzling local. Larry and Stanley put their mapmaking skills to the test.

8.o: In order to get closer to saving Alex, the family must dig into the memories of Cornelius Vanderhouven.

9.o: Pandora, Russ, and Sky head to the jungles of the Yucatan in search of a powerful witch believed to be in possession of a protective amulet.

10.t: The Ruby Hourglass & the Obsidian Sphere
10.o: A major challenge pushes the Vanderhouvens to their limits. Can they overcome the impossible and finally bring Alex back?

1.o: While out with her friends, Seria hears singing. The voice belongs to the ghost of the great Cleopatra.

2.o: An organization of mediums known as TERA harbors Seria to protect her from MiucS.

3.o: Seria joins TERA and visits a part of the Phantom Realm guarded by the ghost of a swordsman.

4.o: Seria and Rui are invited into the inner palace to seduce the ghost of Lord Iemitsu.

5.o: Seria accompanies Riku to an abandoned theme park overrun with ghosts.

6.o: Settei and the girls travel to the Phantom Realm to destroy MiucS' server.

7.o: Seria is captured by Nero, and many of her friends remain trapped in the Phantom Realm.

8.o: Riku joins a group of witches, while Nero prepares for his concert.

9.o: Settei and the others enter Nero's castle to rescue Seria.

10.o: The girls take some time to rest and recover, and Settei meets with an old colleague.

11.o: Seria and her companions confront Odysseus.

12.t: Each Blossoms in Their Own Way
12.o: Yosuke recounts the rise of MiucS and how it changed his world.

1.o: يستعيد "فرانك لامبارد" و"جون تيري" والسير "أليكس فيرغسون" ذكريات وصول "جوزيه مورينيو" الجريء إلى نادي "تشيلسي" عام 2004، ليصبح معروفًا بلقب "الاستثنائي".

2.o: في عام 2007، تختبر صراعات النفوذ وتوترات الملعب مدرب "تشيلسي"، بينما يطمح هو لخوض تحدٍ جديد في الدوري الإيطالي الممتاز رفقة "زلاتان إبراهيموفيتش" و"لويس فيغو".

3.o: في عام 2010، يلتقي ردّ الاعتبار بالتحول الجذري عندما ينضم "جوزيه مورينيو" إلى "ريال مدريد" لإنهاء هيمنة غريمه الذي يعرفه حق المعرفة...
